basic_details.scholarship_name: KTH Royal Institute of Technology Master's Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: KTH Royal Institute of Technology (Kungliga Tekniska högskolan)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: KTH Main Campus & Kista ICT Campus (Stockholm, Sweden)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Master's programmes across all engineering and technology schools, notably School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (EECS): Computer Science, Machine Learning, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, and Information and Network Engineering.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~10% of admitted fee-paying international students receive tuition waivers (~40 to 60 full tuition fee waivers awarded annually)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani engineering graduates typically secure 3 to 6 tuition waivers annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years (120 ECTS credits), subject to passing a minimum of 45 ECTS credits during Year 1

nationality_requirements: Citizens of non-EU/EEA/Swiss countries liable to pay tuition fees in Sweden
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restriction.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related STEM discipline from an HEC-recognized university with high academic distinction (minimum cumulative GPA of 3.50 / 4.00 or 80%+ aggregate; top 10% class standing preferred).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Transcripts are rigorously evaluated on Swedish scale; competitive applicants present high grades in advanced mathematics, algorithms, and systems courses.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial coursework in mathematics (calculus, linear algebra, discrete math, probability) and core computing (algorithms, data structures, computer architecture, programming).
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Students in their final year of undergraduate studies are eligible to apply conditionally.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; leadership, industrial software engineering experience, and technical projects enhance the application profile.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic min 6.5 (no section below 5.5) or TOEFL iBT min 90 (written test min 20). Medium of Instruction letters not accepted for degrees from Pakistan (English 6 requirement).
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; all Master's programmes at KTH are taught entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: None; women in engineering actively encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must rank KTH as their first choice (priority 1) in their Swedish national application on Universityadmissions.se.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot be combined with Swedish Institute (SI) scholarships or other full tuition waivers.

tuition_fee.details: 100% tuition fee waiver covering full tuition costs for the 2-year Master's degree (SEK 320,000 to SEK 380,000 value; ~USD 30,000 to 36,000).

admission_application_fee.details: Swedish national application fee of SEK 900 paid online via Universityadmissions.se.

accommodation.details: KTH accommodation office assists scholarship holders with student housing guarantees (SSSB / KTH housing); rent in student dorms or corridor rooms averages SEK 4,500 to 7,500/month.

monthly_stipend.details: The KTH Scholarship is a tuition waiver only; living costs (approx. SEK 10,314/month required by Swedish Migration Agency) must be covered through personal funds, family savings, or part-time work.

airfare.details: International flights between Pakistan and Stockholm Arlanda (ARN) are self-funded.

visa_fee.details: Swedish Residence Permit for Higher Education application fee of SEK 1,500 paid online to Migrationsverket.

health_insurance.details: All fee-paying and scholarship students are covered by the Swedish state collective insurance plan (FAS+) covering emergency medical and dental care.

food_allowance.details: Groceries and meals self-funded; student kitchens in dorms allow economical self-cooking (~SEK 2,500/month).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Free access to electronic course literature via KTH Library, software licenses, and computing laboratories.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Travel grants available through KTH schools for master's thesis research presented at academic conferences.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to SEK 10,000 per conference presentation

travel_transit_allowance.details: SL student discount provides discounted monthly travelcards for Stockholm metro, buses, commuter trains, and ferries.
travel_transit_allowance.amount: Student discount on Stockholm SL transit

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single premier Swedish engineering institution: KTH Royal Institute of Technology (Stockholm, Sweden)
participating_institutions: School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (EECS)
Center for Autonomous Systems & AI at KTH
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 75 global university (QS World #73, QS Subject Computer Science #54, THE World #97); Sweden's largest and most prestigious technical university.
available_majors: Master's Programme in Software Engineering of Distributed Systems
Master's Programme in Information and Network Engineering
Master's Programme in Interactive Media Technology
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 2 years (120 ECTS credits).
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year BS in CS/STEM with 3.5+ GPA, official transcripts, CV, motivation letter, and IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 90+. KTH must be selected as Priority 1.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Machine Learning and Computer Science are the most competitive programmes with the highest GPA cutoffs; Software Engineering of Distributed Systems, Embedded Systems, and Cybersecurity offer slightly more favorable admission ratios.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: You MUST list KTH as your first priority programme on Universityadmissions.se to be eligible for the KTH Scholarship. Scholarship applications for second-priority choices are not reviewed.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Universityadmissions.se (Swedish National Higher Education Portal) & KTH Scholarship Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create account on Universityadmissions.se, apply for KTH as Priority 1 by mid-January, then submit the dedicated KTH Scholarship application on kth.se in December/January.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (October - January): Apply for KTH Master's programme as Priority 1 on Universityadmissions.se.
Step 2 (By mid-January): Pay the Swedish application fee of SEK 900 online.
Step 3 (Early December - Mid January): Open the dedicated KTH Scholarship application form on kth.se.
Step 4 (In KTH portal): Enter your 8-digit University Admissions application number, upload motivation essay and CV.
Step 5 (By 1 February): Upload all supporting academic documents (transcripts, degree certificates, English test) to Universityadmissions.se.
Step 6 (Late March): Swedish national admission results published on Universityadmissions.se.
Step 7 (Early April): KTH Scholarship recipients officially announced by email.
Step 8 (April - June): Apply for Swedish Residence Permit for Higher Education via Migrationsverket online portal.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Two-step application: Programme admission applied via Universityadmissions.se; KTH Scholarship applied via separate online form on kth.se.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Not required for general KTH admissions or scholarship.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: KTH Scholarship Motivation Essay: Max 500 words explaining why you chose KTH, your academic achievements, and how your studies will contribute to sustainable development goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required at Master's level.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: 1-2 page academic CV detailing education, programming proficiencies, capstone projects, and distinctions.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews; selections made purely through academic assessment and motivation essay review.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT (90+). GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified copies of degree and transcript uploaded to Universityadmissions.se; HEC attestation recommended.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: National application on Universityadmissions.se + scholarship form on kth.se.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight final-year project (FYP) and technical tools.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 10% (Technical projects, bachelor's thesis, publications)

selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: KTH Central Scholarship Committee and School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science Academic Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-tier merit evaluation: Applicants are ranked first by academic performance and grading tier of the home university. High-ranking applicants are then evaluated on their motivation essay and contribution to sustainable development.

competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of NUST, FAST-NUCES, LUMS, and GIKI.

red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: KTH does not work with recruitment agents. Plagiarized or AI-generated motivation essays are disqualified immediately.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: None.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing programme requires formal application during the next admission cycle.

tuition_fee.details: 75% to 100% tuition fee reduction covering full tuition for the 2-year Master's degree (SEK 310,000 to SEK 360,000 value; ~USD 30,000 to 35,000). (Students with top performance in Year 1 receive 85% or 100% in Year 2).

accommodation.details: Student housing through SGS Studentbostäder or Chalmers Studentbostäder (CSB); single rooms or studio flats average SEK 4,200 to 6,500/month.

monthly_stipend.details: The IPOET scholarship covers tuition fees only; living expenses (~SEK 10,314/month required by Swedish Migration Agency) must be covered from personal or family funds.

airfare.details: Travel between Pakistan and Gothenburg Landvetter (GOT) is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: Swedish Residence Permit for Higher Education application fee of SEK 1,500 paid to Migrationsverket.

health_insurance.details: Covered by the Swedish state collective insurance for fee-paying students (FAS+) covering medical and emergency care.

food_allowance.details: Meals and groceries self-funded (~SEK 2,500/month).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Free access to electronic course textbooks via Chalmers Library, computer labs, and engineering software.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Departmental travel grants available for master's thesis research presented at academic conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Västtrafik student discount provides reduced fares across Gothenburg trams, buses, and ferries.
travel_transit_allowance.amount: Student discount on Gothenburg regional transit

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Universityadmissions.se & Chalmers Scholarship Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Apply for Chalmers as Priority 1 on Universityadmissions.se, then fill out the Chalmers Scholarship form on chalmers.se using your 8-digit application number.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (October - January): Apply for Chalmers Master's programme as Priority 1 on Universityadmissions.se.
Step 2 (By mid-January): Pay the Swedish national application fee of SEK 900.
Step 3 (Early December - Mid January): Access the Chalmers Scholarship application form on chalmers.se.
Step 4 (In Chalmers portal): Input your 8-digit application number, select scholarship, and submit your motivation statement.
Step 5 (By 1 February): Upload all transcripts, degree certificates, and English test scores to Universityadmissions.se.
Step 6 (Late March): Swedish national admissions results published.
Step 7 (Early April): Chalmers Scholarship decisions communicated via email.
Step 8 (April - June): Apply for Swedish Residence Permit for Higher Education via Migrationsverket.

application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews; decisions are based purely on academic merit and motivation evaluation.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT (90+). GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified scans uploaded to Universityadmissions.se; HEC attestation recommended.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations required for all non-English documents.

basic_details.scholarship_name: Erasmus Mundus Master in Security and Cloud Computing (SECCLO)
basic_details.offering_entity: European Commission (Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree) & SECCLO Consortium
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Year 1: Aalto University (Finland); Year 2: KTH (Sweden), NTNU (Norway), DTU (Denmark), EURECOM / Institut Polytechnique de Paris (France), or University of Tartu (Estonia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Restricted to the SECCLO joint curriculum: Security and Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Network Security, Cloud Architecture, Mobile and IoT Security, and Big Data Security.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~18 to 22 fully funded Erasmus Mundus scholarships awarded annually to international students worldwide
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global competition under Erasmus+ Partner Countries; Pakistani STEM applicants typically secure 1 to 3 full scholarships per intake
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years (24 months / 120 ECTS credits) across two European partner universities

nationality_requirements: Open to applicants worldwide; Partner Country category covers Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restriction.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or Mathematics from an HEC-recognized university with excellent academic standing (minimum 80% aggregate or CGPA 3.50 / 4.00; top 10% class rank preferred).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Academic transcripts must demonstrate high performance in programming, algorithms, networks, and mathematics.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Solid background in computer networks, operating systems, data structures, algorithms, discrete mathematics, and programming (C/C++, Java, or Python).
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating final-year undergraduate students can apply conditionally; degree certificate must be submitted before July/August.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Industrial cybersecurity, cloud computing, or software engineering experience strongly enhances competitiveness.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic min 6.5 (writing 5.5+) or TOEFL iBT min 92 (writing 22+) or PTE Academic min 62. Medium of Instruction letters are strictly not accepted.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction is 100% in English across all consortium universities.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: None; women in cybersecurity strongly encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Partner Country scholarship rules apply (must not have resided in an EU country for more than 12 months in the last 5 years).
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another EU Erasmus Mundus scholarship simultaneously or have previously received an EMJMD scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition fee waiver covering 100% of consortium tuition fees at both universities for 2 years (EUR 18,000 / year value; total EUR 36,000).

admission_application_fee.details: Application through the SECCLO portal (hosted via Aalto University) is 100% free of charge.

accommodation.details: Paid from monthly living allowance; subsidized student housing in Finland (AYY/HOAS, EUR 350-500/mo) and Year 2 host country (KTH/NTNU/DTU/EURECOM/Tartu, EUR 400-650/mo).

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly subsistence allowance of EUR 1,400 / month (~USD 1,520 / month; ~PKR 434,000 / month) paid for the full 24-month duration of the programme (total EUR 33,600).

airfare.details: Integrated travel allowance: The EUR 1,400/month flat-rate grant under current Erasmus+ rules incorporates travel and relocation allowances.

visa_fee.details: Finnish residence permit fee (EUR 350) and Year 2 host country residence permit fee paid from arrival allowance / monthly stipend.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive private international health, accident, and travel insurance (e.g. Marsh / Dr. Walter) meeting all Erasmus Mundus guidelines fully provided.

food_allowance.details: Living and food costs comfortably covered by the EUR 1,400/month living stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: All course literature, cloud lab environments (AWS, Azure, OpenStack), and research materials provided.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Consortium travel grants available for presenting master's thesis research at security conferences.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to EUR 1,000 per conference presentation

travel_transit_allowance.details: Local student transit discounts available in all consortium host cities (Helsinki, Stockholm, Trondheim, Copenhagen, Sophia Antipolis, Tartu).

university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Year 2 tracks at KTH (Sweden) and EURECOM (France) have highest student demand; NTNU (Norway), DTU (Denmark), and Tartu (Estonia) offer world-class specialized expertise in cryptography and forensics.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Clearly articulate your preferred Year 2 specialization track and explain how your prior background prepares you for that specific track (e.g., cryptography for Tartu, systems for DTU/KTH).

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: SECCLO Online Application System (hosted by Aalto University)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Access the SECCLO application portal during November-January, create an account, select SECCLO, rank your Year 2 track preferences, and upload all required documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (October - November): Review SECCLO Year 2 specialization tracks and prepare course descriptions.
Step 2 (November - December): Take IELTS Academic or TOEFL iBT exam.
Step 3 (Late November - Early January): Fill out online application on the SECCLO application portal.
Step 4 (In portal): Answer motivation questions, indicate Year 2 track preferences, and provide contacts for 2 academic referees.
Step 5 (By deadline): Upload certified PDF scans of degree certificate, transcript of records, CV, and course descriptions.
Step 6 (January - February): Referees submit confidential recommendation letters via automated links.
Step 7 (Late March): Academic selection and Erasmus Mundus scholarship results announced by email.
Step 8 (April - May): Formally accept offer and begin Finnish Residence Permit application for Year 1 at Aalto University.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated single application: Applying to SECCLO automatically serves as an application for the Erasmus Mundus scholarship; no separate scholarship application required.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two academic recommendation letters submitted online via automated referee portal links.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Structured motivation letter answering: (1) Motivation for studying Security and Cloud Computing, (2) Suitability and preparatory background, (3) Preferred Year 2 specialization track and rationale, (4) Future career goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required at Master's level; concise research interests outline integrated into motivation essay.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Europass or clean academic CV detailing education, technical skills, cybersecurity/networking projects, and GitHub links.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews; selections made purely through academic evaluation of application dossiers.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT (92+). GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified copies of degree and transcripts uploaded; verified documents required upon accepting offer.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official authorized English translation required for documents not issued in English.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the SECCLO online application portal.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: IP Paris Online Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the IP Paris portal, select École Polytechnique as host school, choose your Master's programme, upload required documents, and register 2 academic referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (October - December): Review programme curricula on the IP Paris website; verify mathematics and programming prerequisites.
Step 2 (November - January): Prepare statement of purpose, CV, transcripts, and secure agreement from 2 academic referees.
Step 3 (Early January - Mid February): Complete online application on the IP Paris application portal.
Step 4 (In application): Select scholarship interest checkbox to be evaluated for excellence funding.
Step 5 (By deadline): Pay the EUR 80 application fee and submit all documents.
Step 6 (February - March): Referees submit letters; admissions committee reviews dossiers.
Step 7 (Late March - Mid April): Admission and scholarship decisions communicated by email.
Step 8 (April - June): Confirm acceptance, pay deposit (if applicable, waived for full scholars), and initiate Campus France Pakistan visa procedure.

application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: 1 to 2 page academic CV detailing education, programming proficiencies, mathematical background, and distinctions.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Shortlisted applicants may be invited to a 20-30 minute virtual interview evaluating technical problem solving and motivation.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT (90+). GRE is optional.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified copies of degree and transcripts uploaded; verified documents required upon accepting offer.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Access the DTU vacant positions portal, filter by 'PhD', select the specific computing position, click 'Apply online', upload your application dossier, and submit before the vacancy deadline.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (Ongoing): Monitor DTU Career portal for open PhD positions in DTU Compute (vacancies posted year-round).
Step 2 (Project review): Read the specific project description, research objectives, and professor's recent publications.
Step 3 (Document preparation): Prepare a targeted cover letter, academic CV, master's thesis abstract/sample, and transcripts.
Step 4 (Online submission): Apply online via the DTU portal before the project closing deadline.
Step 5 (Shortlisting): The assessment committee evaluates candidates and creates an assessment report.
Step 6 (Interviews): Shortlisted candidates participate in 1-2 technical video interviews and present their master's research.
Step 7 (Employment offer): Formal employment offer letter and contract issued.
Step 8 (Visa & onboarding): Apply for Danish Residence and Work Permit via SIRI; DTU HR assists with relocation.

Step 3 (Ranking proof): Upload official letter from your university confirming you rank in the top 10% of your graduating class.
Step 4 (Scholarship section): In MyInfo, tick the checkbox indicating application for Amsterdam Excellence Scholarship.
Step 5 (AES Motivation Letter): Upload dedicated AES motivation letter (max 500 words) describing your academic excellence and ambitions.
Step 6 (By 15 January): Pay EUR 100 application fee and submit before the strict AES deadline.
Step 7 (February - March): Faculty AES selection committee evaluates and ranks dossiers.
Step 8 (April): Official admission decision and AES award notifications released; accept offer and initiate Dutch visa process.

application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required at Master's level; concise research trajectory outlined in motivation essay.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Submit formal PhD application via Warwick online portal by mid-December, designate prospective supervisor, and check the box to apply for the Chancellor's International Scholarship.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (September - November): Identify prospective PhD supervisors in Warwick Department of Computer Science and initiate email contact with research proposal and CV.
Step 2 (Secure supervisor agreement): Obtain confirmation from a faculty member willing to supervise your doctoral thesis.
Step 3 (By early December): Submit formal online PhD application via Warwick portal.
Step 4 (In application): Under 'Funding', tick the box: 'I would like to be considered for the Chancellor's International Scholarship'.
Step 5 (Upload materials): Upload 2-3 page research proposal, transcripts, CV, and register 2 academic referees.
Step 6 (By mid-December): Ensure both referees submit letters before the strict scholarship deadline.
Step 7 (January - February): Department of Computer Science ranks applicants and nominates top candidates to the University Selection Committee.
Step 8 (Mid-March): Chancellor's International Scholarship results officially announced; receive formal funding letter and CAS for UK visa.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the SNS admissions portal, select your target PhD programme, upload application documents (research proposal, CV, thesis, transcripts), and designate 2 academic referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (December - January): Review PhD research themes and call for applications (Bando di concorso) on the SNS website.
Step 2 (Online registration): Create an account on the SNS application system.
Step 3 (Document preparation): Prepare a detailed research proposal (in English), academic CV, master's thesis abstract/draft, and contact 2 referees.
Step 4 (By early March): Submit online application before the strict deadline (typically 7 March).
Step 5 (Phase 1 evaluation): Selection committee evaluates qualifications and research proposals (candidates scoring 40+/60 are shortlisted).
Step 6 (Phase 2 oral interview): Shortlisted candidates participate in an in-depth oral technical interview via Zoom (scoring 40+/60 required).
Step 7 (Final ranking): Merit ranking published on the SNS website; admission offers issued with full scholarship and free accommodation.
Step 8 (May - July): Formally accept offer and apply for Italian National Long-Stay Visa via Universitaly.it.

eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for MS; research Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or related STEM discipline from an HEC-recognized university with strong academic standing (minimum 75% aggregate or CGPA 3.20 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.50+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum requirement is 70% or 3.0/4.0; College of Computer Science admits typically have 3.40+ on a 4.0 scale.

eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; software development, FPGA/VLSI design, or machine learning projects strongly valued.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic min 6.0, TOEFL iBT min 79, TOEIC min 750, or Duolingo min 105. Institutional Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from Pakistani universities is officially accepted.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; College of Computer Science international graduate programmes are taught 100% in English. Free Chinese language courses provided.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants apply for the scholarship simultaneously on the online admissions portal.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another Taiwan government scholarship (e.g. Taiwan MOE Scholarship) simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition fee waiver covering 100% of university tuition and credit fees (~NTD 120,000 to NTD 150,000 / year value; ~USD 4,000 to 5,000).

admission_application_fee.details: NYCU online application fee of NTD 2,000 (~USD 65) paid online via credit card.

accommodation.details: Subsidized on-campus graduate dormitories at Guangfu campus (Dorm 13, Graduate Dorm) guaranteed for international students; rent averages NTD 2,500 to 4,500/month (~USD 80 to 145/month).

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend: Master's students receive NTD 8,000 to NTD 15,000 / month (~USD 260 to 485 / month; ~PKR 70,000 to 132,000 / month); PhD students receive NTD 22,000 to NTD 32,000 / month (~USD 700 to 1,030 / month; ~PKR 193,000 to 281,000 / month) combining university scholarship and lab advisor top-ups.

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Taipei Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: Taiwan Resident Visa fee of USD 66 paid at Taipei Economic and Cultural Center (TECO) in Dubai/Muscat/Islamabad jurisdiction.

health_insurance.details: After 6 months of continuous residence, students are enrolled in Taiwan's world-renowned National Health Insurance (NHI) program for approx. NTD 826/month (often covered or subsidized by lab).

food_allowance.details: Meals at NYCU campus dining halls and Hsinchu night markets cost only NTD 70 to 120 per meal; easily covered by stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to NYCU Computing Center, AI supercomputers, cleanroom facilities, and laboratory equipment in Hsinchu Science Park.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: National Science and Technology Council (NSTC) travel grants cover international conference travel for students presenting papers.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free NYCU campus shuttle buses connecting Guangfu and Boai campuses; Hsinchu City bus discounts with Taiwan EasyCard.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: NYCU Online International Student Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the NYCU OIA application portal, select semester intake (Fall or Spring), choose up to 3 graduate programmes, tick the scholarship application checkbox, and upload required documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (December - February for Fall / August - September for Spring): Check College of Computer Science lab websites and contact potential advisors.
Step 2 (Online portal): Create account on the NYCU International Student Admissions System.
Step 3 (Scholarship opt-in): On the application form, tick 'Yes' to apply for the NYCU International Student Scholarship.
Step 4 (Upload documents): Upload PDF scans of transcripts, degree certificates, study plan, CV, and English certificate / MOI letter.
Step 5 (Referees): Enter email contacts for 2 academic referees; system automatically emails recommendation requests.
Step 6 (By deadline): Pay NTD 2,000 application fee online and submit.
Step 7 (April - May for Fall): College of Computer Science reviews dossiers and announces admission and scholarship results simultaneously.
Step 8 (May - July): Formally confirm acceptance, receive official admission packet, and apply for Taiwan Resident Visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic application: The scholarship application is processed simultaneously with the admission application through the same portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two academic recommendation letters uploaded directly by referees via automated email links generated by the portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Study Plan / Statement of Purpose: (1) Motivations for choosing NYCU and College of Computer Science, (2) Previous academic and research background, (3) Proposed study schedule and research goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: 1 to 2 page study plan / research outline detailing research topics of interest and relevant lab alignment.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: 1 to 2 page academic CV detailing education, technical competencies, programming skills, capstone projects, and academic honors.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Some faculty lab PIs may conduct a 20-30 minute virtual technical interview via Google Meet to evaluate coding skills and research background.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.0+), TOEFL iBT (79+), Duolingo (105+), or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate. GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified scans uploaded with application; official degree certificates verified by TECO upon arrival.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the NYCU International Student Admissions System.

basic_details.scholarship_name: Peking University (PKU) Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC High-Level Postgraduate Program)
basic_details.offering_entity: China Scholarship Council (CSC) & Peking University (School of Electronics Engineering and Computer Science - EECS)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Peking University Main Campus (Yanyuan / Haidian District, Beijing, China)
basic_details.major_restrictions: School of Electronics Engineering and Computer Science (EECS), School of Computer Science, and Institute for Artificial Intelligence: Computer Science and Technology, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, and Microelectronics.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~80 to 120 full CSC scholarship seats allocated to Peking University across all postgraduate disciplines annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani graduates represent a prominent cohort under Sino-Pak academic collaboration (~8 to 15 awardees annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2-3 years for Master's; up to 4 years for PhD, renewed annually through CSC Annual Review

nationality_requirements: Non-Chinese citizens in good health holding a valid passport
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: CSC statutory age limits: under 35 years of age for Master's applicants; under 40 years of age for Doctoral applicants.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for Master's; recognized Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related STEM field from an HEC-recognized university with high academic distinction (minimum 80% aggregate or CGPA 3.40 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.70+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Peking University evaluates academic excellence rigorously; transcripts must demonstrate high performance in mathematics and core computing coursework.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Rigorous undergraduate training in algorithms, discrete mathematics, computer systems, and programming.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Students in their final undergraduate or master's year can apply; degree completion certificate required before September registration.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior academic publications or strong final-year research thesis significantly enhance competitiveness.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: For English-taught programs: IELTS Academic min 6.5, TOEFL iBT min 90, or institutional English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate. For Chinese-taught programs: HSK Level 6 (min 180 points) required.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None for English-taught graduate streams. Basic Chinese language courses provided.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates apply through the CSC Type B (University Program) using Peking University agency code (10001). Pre-acceptance from a PKU professor is strongly recommended.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another Chinese government or university scholarship simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: 100% tuition waiver covering full postgraduate tuition fees (~CNY 30,000 to CNY 40,000 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: Peking University international student online application fee of CNY 800 paid online via credit card.

accommodation.details: Free on-campus accommodation in PKU international student dormitories (Zhongguanyuan Global Village or Shaoyuan) in a twin room (Master's) or single room (PhD); or a monthly housing subsidy of CNY 700 (Master's) / CNY 1,000 (PhD) if living off campus.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend provided by CSC: CNY 3,000 / month for Master's students (~USD 420 / month; ~PKR 117,000 / month); CNY 3,500 / month for PhD students (~USD 490 / month; ~PKR 136,500 / month) tax-free.

airfare.details: International flights between Pakistan and Beijing Capital International (PEK) / Daxing (PKX) are self-funded.

visa_fee.details: Chinese Student Visa (X1 Visa) application fee paid to Chinese Visa Application Service Center in Islamabad/Karachi (~PKR 12,000 to 16,000).

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive Medical Insurance Scheme for International Students in China (Ping An Insurance, CNY 800/year value) fully provided by CSC.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized campus canteens (Nongyuan, Yanyuan, Xuanyuan) offer high-quality hot meals for CNY 15 to 25 per meal; covered comfortably from stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Peking University Library, high-performance computing clusters, and EECS laboratory resources.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Faculty research grants cover travel and registration for students presenting papers at academic conferences.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: PKU International Student Application Portal & CSC Online Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Submit applications on TWO portals: (1) CSC portal (campuschina.org) using PKU Agency Code 10001 (Program Category B); (2) PKU portal (studyatpku.com), upload all documents, and pay the PKU application fee.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (October - December): Review PKU EECS faculty research profiles and contact prospective supervisors to obtain a pre-acceptance letter.
Step 2 (CSC Portal): Register on campuschina.org, select Program Category B, input Agency Code 10001 (Peking University), and complete the CSC form.
Step 3 (PKU Portal): Register on studyatpku.com, fill out the international postgraduate application, and choose Chinese Government Scholarship.
Step 4 (Upload materials): Upload transcripts, degree certificates, study plan (1,500+ words), CV, 2 recommendation letters, Foreigner Physical Examination Form, and police clearance certificate.
Step 5 (By deadline): Pay CNY 800 application fee on the PKU portal and submit before the January deadline.
Step 6 (February - March): Department of Computer Science reviews dossiers and conducts technical video interviews.
Step 7 (April - May): PKU nominates selected candidates to the China Scholarship Council for final approval.
Step 8 (June - July): Official admission packet and JW201 visa form dispatched; apply for Chinese X1 Visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Dual-portal application: Candidate must apply on the CSC portal (Agency Code 10001) AND the PKU admissions portal simultaneously.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors uploaded directly to both portals.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Detailed Statement of Purpose / Research Proposal (over 1,500 words for PhD; over 1,000 words for Master's) in English detailing academic background, research objectives, methodology, and why PKU.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Comprehensive research proposal outlining specific research questions, theoretical framework, methodology, and proposed supervisor alignment.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic CV listing education, technical proficiencies, research publications, and capstone projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 20-30 minute virtual technical interview via Tencent Meeting / Zoom conducted by the departmental admissions committee evaluating academic background and research motivation.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.5+), TOEFL iBT (90+), or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate. GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Notarized copies of degree and transcripts uploaded; HEC attestation and MOFA attestation recommended for Pakistani credentials.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Notarized Chinese or English translations required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Dual digital submission via campuschina.org and studyatpku.com.

basic_details.scholarship_name: Fudan University Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC High-Level Postgraduate Program)
basic_details.offering_entity: China Scholarship Council (CSC) & Fudan University (School of Computer Science)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Fudan University Handan & Jiangwan Campuses (Shanghai, China)
basic_details.major_restrictions: School of Computer Science, Academy for Engineering & Technology, and School of Data Science: Computer Science and Technology, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, and Big Data Systems.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~70 to 100 full CSC scholarship seats allocated to Fudan University across all postgraduate faculties annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global merit competition; Pakistani students secure ~6 to 12 fully funded seats annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2-3 years for Master's; up to 4 years for PhD, renewed annually through CSC Annual Review

nationality_requirements: Non-Chinese citizens in good health holding a valid passport
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: CSC statutory age limits: under 35 years of age for Master's applicants; under 40 years of age for Doctoral applicants.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for Master's; recognized Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related STEM field from an HEC-recognized university with high academic standing (minimum 80% aggregate or CGPA 3.40 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.65+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Transcripts are evaluated rigorously on mathematics and computing foundations; admissions committee looks for strong grades in algorithms, programming, and discrete math.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial coursework in programming, data structures, algorithms, discrete mathematics, computer architecture, and linear algebra.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Students in their final undergraduate or master's year can apply; degree completion certificate required before September registration.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior academic publications or strong final-year research thesis significantly enhance competitiveness.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: For English-taught programs: IELTS Academic min 6.5, TOEFL iBT min 90, or institutional English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate. For Chinese-taught programs: HSK Level 5 or 6 required.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None for English-taught graduate streams. Basic Chinese language courses provided.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates apply through CSC Type B (University Program) using Fudan University agency code (10246). Pre-acceptance from a Fudan professor is strongly recommended.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another Chinese government or university scholarship simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: 100% tuition waiver covering full postgraduate tuition fees (~CNY 30,000 to CNY 38,000 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: Fudan University international student online application fee of CNY 800 paid online via credit card.

accommodation.details: Free on-campus accommodation in Fudan Foreign Student Dormitory (Handan or Jiangwan campus) in a twin room (Master's) or single room (PhD); or a monthly housing subsidy of CNY 700 (Master's) / CNY 1,000 (PhD) if living off campus.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend provided by CSC: CNY 3,000 / month for Master's students (~USD 420 / month; ~PKR 117,000 / month); CNY 3,500 / month for PhD students (~USD 490 / month; ~PKR 136,500 / month) tax-free.

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Shanghai Pudong International Airport (PVG) is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: Chinese Student Visa (X1 Visa) application fee paid to Chinese Visa Application Service Center in Islamabad/Karachi (~PKR 12,000 to 16,000).

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive Medical Insurance Scheme for International Students in China (Ping An Insurance, CNY 800/year value) fully provided by CSC.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized campus canteens (Danzhong, Beiyuan, Jiangwan) offer diverse meals for CNY 15 to 25 per meal; covered comfortably from stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Fudan University Library system, Jiangwan compute clusters, and School of Computer Science laboratories.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Faculty research grants cover travel and registration for students presenting papers at academic conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Shanghai Metro and public transit card provides heavily subsidized transit throughout Shanghai (metro fares start at CNY 3).

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Fudan University International Student Application Portal & CSC Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Submit applications on TWO portals: (1) CSC portal (campuschina.org) using Fudan Agency Code 10246 (Program Category B); (2) Fudan portal (istudent.fudan.edu.cn/apply), upload all documents, and pay the Fudan application fee.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (October - December): Explore research laboratories in Fudan School of Computer Science and email professors to secure a pre-acceptance letter.
Step 2 (CSC Portal): Register on campuschina.org, choose Category B, enter Agency Code 10246 (Fudan University), and complete the CSC form.
Step 3 (Fudan Portal): Register on istudent.fudan.edu.cn/apply, fill out the international graduate application, and select Chinese Government Scholarship.
Step 4 (Upload documents): Upload transcripts, degree certificates, study plan (1,000+ words), CV, 2 recommendation letters, Foreigner Physical Examination Form, and police clearance certificate.
Step 5 (By deadline): Pay CNY 800 application fee on the Fudan portal and submit before the January deadline.
Step 6 (February - March): School of Computer Science evaluates dossiers and conducts virtual technical interviews.
Step 7 (April - May): Fudan University nominates selected candidates to the China Scholarship Council for final approval.
Step 8 (June - July): Official admission packet and JW201 visa form dispatched; apply for Chinese X1 Visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Dual-portal application: Candidate must apply on the CSC portal (Agency Code 10246) AND the Fudan admissions portal simultaneously.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors uploaded directly to both portals.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Study Plan / Research Proposal (over 1,000 words) in English detailing academic background, research objectives, methodology, and why Fudan.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research proposal outlining specific research questions, theoretical framework, methodology, and proposed supervisor alignment.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic CV listing education, technical proficiencies, research publications, and capstone projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 20-30 minute virtual technical interview via Tencent Meeting / Zoom conducted by the departmental admissions committee evaluating academic background and research motivation.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.5+), TOEFL iBT (90+), or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate. GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Notarized copies of degree and transcripts uploaded; HEC attestation and MOFA attestation recommended for Pakistani credentials.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Notarized Chinese or English translations required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Dual digital submission via campuschina.org and istudent.fudan.edu.cn/apply.

basic_details.scholarship_name: Nagoya University NUPACE & IGP MEXT Fellowship
basic_details.offering_entity: Japanese Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT) & Nagoya University
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Nagoya University Higashiyama Campus (Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture, Japan)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Graduate School of Informatics (Department of Computer Science, Department of Intelligence Science and Technology), Graduate School of Engineering, and International Graduate Program (IGP).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~35 to 50 University-Recommended MEXT scholarships awarded annually across Nagoya University graduate schools
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition under MEXT General Category; Pakistani students secure ~3 to 6 awards annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for Master's; up to 3 years for PhD (plus 6 months Japanese preparatory period if required)

nationality_requirements: Citizens of countries that have diplomatic relations with Japan (Pakistan eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Applicants must be born on or after April 2 of the year corresponding to under 35 years of age at intake.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for Master's; recognized Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD in Computer Science, Information Science, or related STEM field from an HEC-recognized university with minimum cumulative GPA of 3.30 / 4.00 (MEXT grade point average of 2.30 / 3.00 scale or higher required; competitive admits typically 3.60+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Must satisfy MEXT grade conversion formula: Minimum 2.30 on MEXT 3.0 scale over past two academic years.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Rigorous undergraduate training in algorithms, discrete mathematics, computer architecture, programming, and software engineering.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Students in their final undergraduate or master's year can apply conditionally; degree completion certificate required before September arrival.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; prior research experience and academic publications significantly strengthen the nomination.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic min 6.5, TOEFL iBT min 80, TOEIC min 730, or institutional English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate. Japanese language proficiency (JLPT) is not required for IGP.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and research conducted entirely in English in the Graduate School of Informatics IGP.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must obtain formal acceptance/endorsement from a prospective Nagoya University professor before applying.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Those who have received a MEXT scholarship in the past must have at least 3 years of educational/work experience before applying again.

tuition_fee.details: Full exemption of university admission examination fee (JPY 30,000), enrollment fee (JPY 282,000), and annual tuition fees (JPY 535,800 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: Application examination fee of JPY 30,000 is 100% waived for MEXT scholarship nominees.

accommodation.details: Nagoya University International Residences (Foreign Student House, Idaka-cho, Noyori Conference Hall) provided for initial 6-12 months at highly subsidized rates (JPY 15,000 to 30,000/month; ~USD 100 to 200/month); private apartments average JPY 35,000 to 55,000/month.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living stipend paid by MEXT: JPY 144,000 / month for Master's students (~USD 960 / month; ~PKR 273,600 / month); JPY 145,000 / month for PhD students (~USD 970 / month; ~PKR 275,500 / month) for the full duration of study.

airfare.details: Economy-class international flight ticket from Pakistan (Islamabad/Lahore/Karachi) to Chubu Centrair International Airport (NGO) / Tokyo at the beginning, and return flight upon degree completion, fully covered by MEXT.

visa_fee.details: Japanese College Student Visa issued free of charge at the Embassy of Japan in Islamabad or Consulate-General in Karachi upon receipt of MEXT certificate.

health_insurance.details: Mandatory Japanese National Health Insurance (NHI) covers 70% of all medical costs; student premium is heavily subsidized (~JPY 1,500 to 2,000/month; ~PKR 3,000 to 4,000/month), paid out of stipend.

food_allowance.details: Campus cafeterias (Meidai Co-op dining halls, Meidai Halal Food corners) offer wholesome meals for JPY 400 to 600 per meal; easily covered by the JPY 144,000/month stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Nagoya University Central Library, Information Technology Center supercomputing clusters, and Informatics lab hardware.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Laboratory JSPS Kakenhi research grants cover domestic and international conference travel expenses for research presentations.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Nagoya Subway and Meitetsu train student commuter passes provide 50% discount on transit; Higashiyama campus has direct subway station.

university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Intelligence Science and Technology (AI/Computer Vision/Robotics) attracts significant applicant competition; Computer Science (Algorithms, Systems, Architecture) offers higher selection probability for candidates with solid mathematical and systems preparation.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Nagoya University Graduate School of Informatics Admissions Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Review faculty directory on the Graduate School of Informatics website, contact prospective professor with CV and research plan, obtain provisional acceptance, then submit formal application materials to the graduate school admissions office.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (September - November): Review faculty research labs in Graduate School of Informatics and initiate contact with prospective supervisor with CV, transcripts, and research proposal.
Step 2 (Secure supervisor agreement): Obtain informal agreement to supervise from a professor (Letter of Provisional Acceptance).
Step 3 (November - December): Receive formal MEXT University Recommendation application guidelines from the prospective professor or graduate school office.
Step 4 (Document compilation): Prepare MEXT application form, field of study and study program form, certified transcripts, degree certificates, and 2 recommendation letters.
Step 5 (By mid-January): Submit completed application package to the Graduate School of Informatics.
Step 6 (February): Graduate school conducts internal screening and interviews nominees.
Step 7 (March): Nagoya University formally nominates selected candidates to MEXT.
Step 8 (June - July): MEXT officially approves nominations; recipient receives air ticket and visa instructions for September arrival.

application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing education, programming proficiencies, research publications, and capstone projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 30-45 minute technical video interview via Zoom conducted by prospective supervisor and departmental committee evaluating research proposal, mathematical problem solving, and English fluency.

application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Japanese translations required for all non-English documents.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Tohoku University GSIS Admissions & TAO Online Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Review GSIS faculty list, obtain provisional acceptance from a professor, then submit formal application materials via the designated online application system (TAO / email submission).
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (September - November): Contact prospective GSIS faculty supervisor with CV, transcripts, and research plan.
Step 2 (Secure endorsement): Obtain informal acceptance to supervise from the professor.
Step 3 (Receive application forms): Receive MEXT University Recommendation application guidelines and forms.
Step 4 (Document compilation): Complete MEXT application form, field of study form, certified transcripts, degree certificates, and 2 recommendation letters.
Step 5 (By mid-January): Submit completed application package to the GSIS admissions office.
Step 6 (February): GSIS conducts internal document screening and technical video interview.
Step 7 (March): Tohoku University nominates selected candidates to MEXT.
Step 8 (June - July): MEXT officially approves nominations; recipient receives air ticket and visa documentation for October arrival.

application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 30-45 minute technical video interview via Zoom conducted by prospective supervisor and departmental committee evaluating research proposal, mathematical problem solving, and English fluency.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.5+), TOEFL iBT (80+), or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate. GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified copies of degree and transcripts uploaded; HEC attestation recommended for Pakistani credentials.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Japanese translations required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Digital submission to graduate school office followed by physical mailing of original certified documents upon request.

Step 8 (Arrival & contract): Travel to Penang, complete medical checkup, register at IPS, and sign GRA employment contract with research supervisor.

basic_details.scholarship_name: Kyushu University ISEE International Graduate Program & MEXT Honors
basic_details.offering_entity: Kyushu University & Japanese Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Kyushu University Ito Main Campus (Fukuoka, Kyushu, Japan)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Graduate School of Information Science and Electrical Engineering (ISEE): Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Information Science, and Artificial Intelligence.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~30 to 45 University-Recommended MEXT scholarships and Kyushu University Friendship Scholarships awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani graduates represent a prominent cohort in ISEE (~4 to 8 awardees annually)

nationality_requirements: Citizens of countries holding diplomatic relations with Japan (Pakistan eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Under 35 years of age on October 1 of intake year for MEXT track.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for Master's; research Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD in Computer Science, Information Science, Electrical Engineering, or related STEM field from an HEC-recognized university with high academic standing (minimum 75% aggregate or CGPA 3.20 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.50+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Must satisfy MEXT grade conversion formula: Minimum 2.30 on MEXT 3.0 scale over past two academic years.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Rigorous undergraduate training in algorithms, discrete mathematics, computer architecture, programming, and software engineering.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Students in their final undergraduate or master's year can apply conditionally; degree completion certificate required before arrival.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; prior research experience and academic publications significantly strengthen the nomination.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic min 6.5, TOEFL iBT min 80, TOEIC min 730, or institutional English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from Pakistani university.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and research conducted entirely in English in the ISEE International Graduate Program.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must obtain formal acceptance/endorsement from a prospective Kyushu University professor before applying.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another government scholarship simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: Full exemption of university admission examination fee (JPY 30,000), enrollment fee (JPY 282,000), and annual tuition fees (JPY 535,800 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: Application examination fee of JPY 30,000 is 100% waived for MEXT scholarship nominees.

accommodation.details: Kyushu University Ito Harmony House or Dormitory 1/2/3 provided for initial 6-12 months at highly subsidized rates (JPY 15,000 to 28,000/month; ~USD 100 to 185/month); private apartments in Fukuoka average JPY 30,000 to 45,000/month.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living stipend paid by MEXT: JPY 144,000 / month for Master's students (~USD 960 / month; ~PKR 273,600 / month); JPY 145,000 / month for PhD students (~USD 970 / month; ~PKR 275,500 / month) for the full duration of study.

airfare.details: Economy-class international flight ticket from Pakistan (Islamabad/Lahore/Karachi) to Fukuoka Airport (FUK) at the beginning, and return flight upon degree completion, fully covered by MEXT.

visa_fee.details: Japanese College Student Visa issued free of charge at the Embassy of Japan in Islamabad upon receipt of MEXT certificate.

health_insurance.details: Mandatory Japanese National Health Insurance (NHI) covers 70% of medical costs; student monthly premium is heavily subsidized (~JPY 1,500 to 2,000/month), paid out of stipend.

food_allowance.details: Campus Co-op cafeterias (Big Orange, Big Sand, Shiiki Hall dining) offer wholesome meals for JPY 400 to 600 per meal; easily covered by the JPY 144,000/month stipend in affordable Fukuoka.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Kyushu University Central Library, Research Institute for Information Technology supercomputing clusters, and ISEE laboratories.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Laboratory JSPS Kakenhi research funds cover travel and registration for presenting papers at domestic and international conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Showa Bus connects Ito campus with Kyudai-Gakkentoshi station; student commuter passes provide reduced fares.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Kyushu University ISEE Admissions & International Student Office
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Review faculty directory on the ISEE website, contact prospective professor with CV and research plan, obtain provisional acceptance, then submit formal application materials to the graduate school admissions office.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (September - November): Review faculty research labs in Graduate School of ISEE and initiate contact with prospective supervisor with CV, transcripts, and research proposal.
Step 2 (Secure supervisor agreement): Obtain informal agreement to supervise from a professor (Letter of Provisional Acceptance).
Step 3 (November - December): Receive formal MEXT University Recommendation application guidelines from the prospective professor or graduate school office.
Step 4 (Document compilation): Prepare MEXT application form, field of study form, certified transcripts, degree certificates, and 2 recommendation letters.
Step 5 (By mid-January): Submit completed application package to the Graduate School of ISEE.
Step 6 (February): Graduate school conducts internal screening and interviews nominees.
Step 7 (March): Kyushu University formally nominates selected candidates to MEXT.
Step 8 (June - July): MEXT officially approves nominations; recipient receives air ticket and visa instructions for October arrival.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated University Recommendation track: Candidates apply directly through Kyushu University; the university nominates selected candidates to MEXT.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two confidential recommendation letters addressed to the Dean of ISEE / President of Kyushu University, signed by university Dean or supervising professor.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Field of Study and Research Program Plan (MEXT standard form): (1) Past research background and achievements, (2) Detailed research plan in Japan (purpose, methodology, expected results, bibliography).
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured 3 to 5-page research proposal detailing problem statement, research significance, proposed methodology, technical approach, and schedule of research in Japan.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing education, programming proficiencies, research publications, and capstone projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 30-45 minute technical video interview via Zoom conducted by prospective supervisor and departmental committee evaluating research proposal, mathematical problem solving, and English fluency.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.5+), TOEFL iBT (80+), or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate. GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified copies of degree and transcripts uploaded; HEC attestation recommended for Pakistani credentials.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Japanese translations required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Digital submission to graduate school office followed by physical mailing of original certified documents upon request.

nationality_requirements: International applicants holding non-Korean citizenship whose parents are also non-Korean
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restriction.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for MS; recognized Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related STEM field from an HEC-recognized university with strong academic standing (minimum 75% aggregate or CGPA 3.20 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.50+ / 4.00).

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; graduate research and coursework in Computer Software are conducted 100% in English. Free Korean language classes offered on campus.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: HISP is awarded automatically based on admissions dossier review (no separate application). Lab professors frequently provide living stipends via BK21 (Brain Korea 21) funds.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another Korean government full tuition scholarship simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: 100% tuition waiver (HISP 100% tier) covering full graduate tuition fees (~KRW 6,500,000 to KRW 7,500,000 / semester; ~KRW 14,000,000 / year value; ~USD 10,500 / year).

admission_application_fee.details: Hanyang University international graduate online application fee of KRW 138,000 (~USD 100) paid online via credit card.

airfare.details: International flights between Pakistan and Seoul Incheon International Airport (ICN) are self-funded.

food_allowance.details: Campus cafeterias (Saraban, Student Union dining) offer hot Korean and international meals for KRW 4,500 to 6,500 per meal; easily covered by the monthly lab stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Hanyang Paiknam Academic Information Center, GPU clusters, AI servers, and software licenses in the College of Computing.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: BK21 Four and NRF research grants cover full travel, registration, and hotel costs for presenting research papers at international conferences.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Hanyang University International Graduate Admissions Portal & StudyinKorea Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Hanyang OIA online application portal during the application window (September-October for Spring; March-April for Fall), complete personal details, upload required documents, and submit before deadline.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (August - September for Spring / January - February for Fall): Explore Hanyang CS faculty lab websites and email prospective professors with CV and research statement.
Step 2 (Online portal): Access the Hanyang University International Graduate Admissions online portal.
Step 3 (Complete application): Fill out application form, select target degree program, and indicate prospective lab supervisor (if contacted).
Step 4 (Upload documents): Upload certified PDF scans of transcripts, degree certificates, study plan, CV, 2 recommendation letters, and English certificate / MOI letter.
Step 5 (Fee payment): Pay KRW 138,000 application fee online and submit.
Step 6 (Faculty review & interview): College of Computing admissions committee reviews dossiers and may conduct virtual interviews.
Step 7 (Admission & HISP announcement): Admission decision and HISP scholarship award notification released simultaneously on the portal.
Step 8 (Certificate of Admission): Formally accept offer, receive Certificate of Admission (CoA), and apply for Korean D-2 Student Visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic consideration: All international applicants are automatically evaluated for the HISP scholarship based on their application dossier; no separate scholarship application required.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two academic recommendation letters uploaded directly to the admissions portal or submitted by referees via automated links.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Study Plan / Statement of Purpose: (1) Motivations for choosing Hanyang University, (2) Previous academic and research achievements, (3) Detailed study and research plan in target field, (4) Future career goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured 2 to 3-page study plan detailing research interests, technical tools, and prospective lab alignment.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing education, programming proficiencies, research publications, and capstone projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Some faculty lab PIs conduct a 20-30 minute virtual technical interview via Zoom to evaluate coding proficiency and research background before confirming lab placement.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.0+), TOEFL iBT (80+), or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate. GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Notarized or apostilled degree certificates and transcripts uploaded; HEC attestation and MOFA attestation required for Pakistani credentials.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Notarized English translations required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the Hanyang International Graduate Admissions portal.

official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some online blogs state that HISP renewal requires a 4.0 GPA. In fact, maintaining the HISP scholarship requires maintaining a minimum GPA of 3.00 on a 4.0 scale each semester.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.00 or higher each semester to retain the HISP tuition waiver for the following semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research enrollment on campus in Seoul or ERICA.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-by-semester credit completion and GPA verification by the Office of International Affairs.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: International students holding a D-2 visa can work part-time up to 20 hours per week during term time and 40 hours per week during vacations with immigration permission.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: No clawback of previously awarded funds; semester GPA falling below 3.0 results in loss of tuition waiver for subsequent term.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing department requires formal approval from both departments.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Master's scholarship capped at 2 years; PhD scholarship capped at 4 years. Professor funding can continue beyond.
