basic_details.scholarship_name: Nanjing University Chinese Government Scholarship - High Level Postgraduate Program (CSC Type B)
basic_details.offering_entity: China Scholarship Council (CSC) & Nanjing University (NJU)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Nanjing University (Xianlin, Gulou, and Pukou Campuses, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, China)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all accredited graduate programs at NJU with strategic priority in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science and Technology, Electronic Science and Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Astronomy, Chemistry, Physics, and International Business.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~120 to 160 university-nominated CSC High-Level Postgraduate scholarships awarded annually across all disciplines
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani postgraduates represent one of the largest national contingents (~15 to 25 recipients annually across STEM faculties)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 to 3 years for Master's; up to 3 to 4 years for PhD programs

nationality_requirements: Citizens of a country other than the People's Republic of China (Pakistan eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Applicants for Master's degree programs must be under 35 years of age; applicants for Doctoral programs must be under 40 years of age.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for Master's applicants; Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD applicants from an HEC-recognized university with high academic achievement (minimum 75% aggregate or CGPA 3.20 / 4.00; competitive admits typically maintain 3.50+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Grades converted to CSC 4.0 scale; applicants should rank in the top 20% of their graduating class.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Relevant undergraduate/postgraduate degree corresponding directly to the applied research discipline.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating university seniors in their final semester can apply conditionally with an official pre-graduation bonafide certificate.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: None, provided age and degree eligibility parameters are satisfied.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior academic publications in SCI/EI indexed journals or patent filings significantly elevate PhD competitiveness.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: For English-taught majors: IELTS Academic min 6.0 (6.5 preferred for computing/business) or TOEFL iBT min 85. Official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificates from Pakistani HEC-recognized universities are widely accepted by NJU academic supervisors.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: For Chinese-taught programs: HSK Level 5 with a score of 180 or above is mandatory.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must secure a provisional Acceptance Letter (Pre-Admission Supervision Notice) from an accredited NJU professor/supervisor prior to final institutional review.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold any concurrent Chinese Government, provincial, or municipal scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition fee waiver for the complete official degree duration (RMB 32,000 to 45,000 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: Nanjing University international application fee of RMB 600 (~USD 85; ~PKR 23,500) payable upon submission of the institutional portal.

accommodation.details: Free on-campus accommodation provided in university international student dormitories (single room for PhD students, shared twin room for Master's students) on Xianlin or Gulou Campus, or monthly housing subsidy of RMB 700 to 1,000 if living off-campus with university approval.

monthly_stipend.details: Standard China Scholarship Council monthly living stipend: RMB 3,000 / month for Master's students (~USD 420; ~PKR 117,000 / month); RMB 3,500 / month for PhD students (~USD 490; ~PKR 136,500 / month).

airfare.details: International round-trip travel expenses between Pakistan and Nanjing are self-funded by the scholar.

visa_fee.details: Chinese X1 Student Visa application fees and medical examination fees in Pakistan are borne by the student.
visa_fee.amount: Not covered (~PKR 25,000 to 35,000 for visa and medical)

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive Medical Insurance for International Students in China provided by Ping An Insurance (RMB 800 / year value).

food_allowance.details: University canteens (including halal-certified cafeterias on Xianlin and Gulou campuses) provide subsidized meals for RMB 20 to 35/day; easily covered by the monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Nanjing University libraries, scientific databases, high-performance computing clusters, and laboratory research facilities.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Research project supplies, fieldwork, and domestic academic conferences funded through supervisor's National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC) grants.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Local subway, bus, and high-speed rail transit between Shanghai/Nanjing and campus is paid from stipend.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (Nanjing University)
participating_institutions: Nanjing University (NJU) - C9 League Institution (Jiangsu, China)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #145, ARWU Shanghai Ranking #80 worldwide, Chinese C9 League elite university.
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master's: 2 to 3 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Online NJU application, supervisor acceptance letter, notarized academic transcripts and degree certificates, two professor recommendation letters, detailed research proposal (800+ words for Master's, 1,500+ words for PhD), Foreigner Physical Examination Form, and clean police character certificate.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Securing a pre-acceptance letter from faculty in the School of Computer Science or School of Artificial Intelligence is exceptionally competitive due to global demand; applicants with published papers in IEEE/ACM transactions or top conferences receive rapid supervisor endorsements.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Contact prospective NJU supervisors between October and December. Send a concise cold email highlighting your publication record, GitHub repository, and an aligned 2-page research draft before submitting the formal CSC portal application.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: CSC Online Application System (Agency No. 10284) & NJU International Student Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the CSC portal selecting 'Program Category Type B', input NJU Agency Number '10284'. Concurrently register on the NJU International Student Service System and upload matching documentation.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore NJU faculty profiles and reach out to prospective supervisors with CV and research abstract (October - December).
Step 2: Secure the formal NJU 'Provisional Acceptance Letter for International Students' signed by the professor and school.
Step 3: Complete CSC online registration under Type B (Agency No. 10284) and download the completed CSC application form.
Step 4: Complete NJU International Student Portal application and upload all notarized academic credentials, physical exam, and police certificate.
Step 5: Pay the NJU application fee (RMB 600) online via UnionPay, WeChat, or international credit card.
Step 6: School-level academic committee reviews dossiers and conducts online technical interviews (February - March).
Step 7: NJU nominates shortlisted candidates to the China Scholarship Council in Beijing for final approval (April - May).
Step 8: Final CSC award list announced; official JW201 visa form and NJU admission notice dispatched (June - July).
Step 9: Apply for Chinese X1 Student Visa at Chinese Visa Application Service Centre (Gerry's) in Pakistan and arrive in Nanjing in September.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Direct University Track (Type B): The university evaluates, interviews, and directly nominates candidates to CSC.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by applicant as signed PDF letters on institutional letterhead with recommender email and phone details.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Comprehensive Statement of Purpose / Research Proposal covering academic background, proposed research methodology, justification for choosing Nanjing University, and long-term professional aspirations (minimum 800 words for Master's; 1,500 words for PhD).
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research proposal detailing problem statement, literature review, technical methodology, expected timeline, and alignment with prospective supervisor's research group.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing education history, published papers, academic awards, technical programming skillsets, and referee details.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 30-minute online video interview via Tencent Meeting (VooV) or Zoom conducted by NJU departmental faculty panel, evaluating technical depth, research feasibility, and English communication.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: None strictly required (GRE not mandatory); English proficiency test or MOI letter required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Educational degrees and transcripts must be notarized by a licensed Notary Public in Pakistan and subsequently attested by HEC and MoFA for final registration.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official English or Chinese translations required for any non-English/non-Chinese certificates.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via CSC and NJU online portals; physical hardcopies not required unless requested by specific faculty.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Research publications, supervisor fit, and proposal rigor)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Study plan clarity and articulation of research goals)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 5% (Strength and specificity of academic referee endorsements)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 10% (Oral defense, technical aptitude, and English fluency)

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~3,500 to 5,000 international applicants across all disciplines
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~120 to 160 CSC Type B scholarships awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~5.0% among applicants possessing an official supervisor acceptance letter
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.50+ / 4.00 or 80%+ aggregate from leading Pakistani institutions (NUST, QAU, UET, FAST, LUMS, COMSATS)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Strong theoretical foundation, at least 1-2 published papers or indexed conference proceedings, and an endorsed research plan aligned with NJU lab priorities.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of top Pakistani public and private engineering/science universities with tangible laboratory experience.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Russia, South Korea, Vietnam, Indonesia, Kazakhstan, France, Nigeria.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of fraudulent educational agency websites claiming guaranteed CSC admission to Nanjing University for an upfront fee.
Legitimate applications are processed ONLY through studyinchina.csc.edu.cn and istudy.nju.edu.cn.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: NJU charges an official non-refundable application fee of RMB 600; CSC application itself is completely free. Never pay agent processing fees.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Nanjing University does not collaborate with any commercial educational agencies for CSC scholarship distribution. Direct supervisor contact is essential.
hidden_costs_breakdown: RMB 600 NJU application fee.
Pakistani medical checkup and MoFA attestation expenses (~PKR 30,000 to 45,000).
Round-trip airfare from Pakistan to Shanghai/Nanjing (~PKR 180,000 to 220,000).
Initial 1-month living buffer before first stipend release (~RMB 2,500; ~PKR 100,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You cannot get CSC without knowing Chinese. Reality: NJU offers dozens of world-class graduate programs taught 100% in English.
Myth: An acceptance letter guarantees the scholarship. Reality: Acceptance letters pass the departmental hurdle, but final CSC approval depends on institutional quota allocation.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial blogs suggest submitting physical hard copies to Nanjing; NJU transitioned to an entirely paperless online portal submission.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance (grade equivalent to 70%+ or passing all coursework) in accordance with NJU Graduate School regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Strict attendance in lectures and active daily presence in research laboratories as directed by the principal investigator.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual CSC Comprehensive Scholarship Review (April - May) evaluating coursework, research progress, and supervisor feedback; failure results in suspension or termination of stipend.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Off-campus employment is strictly prohibited under Chinese immigration laws without explicit university endorsement and work-study visa notation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None enforced by CSC; graduates may pursue post-doctoral fellowships, industry employment in China under working visas, or international research careers.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: No financial bond or service indenture required.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Stipend and tuition benefits terminated if scholar is expelled for disciplinary breaches, severe violation of Chinese law, or unapproved program abandonment.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Changing university while under CSC scholarship is strictly forbidden.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Major changes are generally not permitted unless approved under extraordinary circumstances by NJU Graduate School and CSC Beijing.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship extensions are extremely rare and generally require supervisor research funding coverage if PhD studies exceed the approved duration.

university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Online application on Beihang International Student portal and CSC portal, supervisor acceptance letter, notarized academic credentials, study plan (1,000+ words), two professor recommendation letters, physical exam form, and police clearance certificate.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Aerospace, UAV design, and Robotics research groups are world-renowned and receive intense competition; early contact with professors in the School of Aeronautic Science or Computer Science is paramount.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Highlight hands-on hardware/software engineering skills (e.g., ROS, CFD simulations, embedded systems, PyTorch) in your initial supervisor outreach email.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Beihang University International Student Service System & CSC Portal (Agency No. 10006)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on Beihang portal (admission.buaa.edu.cn) and submit personal credentials. Complete CSC Type B application specifying Beihang Agency Number '10006'.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Identify potential research supervisors from Beihang academic school websites and send tailored email with CV and research interests (October - December).
Step 2: Obtain the official Beihang Provisional Acceptance Letter signed by the supervisor.
Step 3: Register and complete the online application on the Beihang International Student Portal.
Step 4: Register on the CSC online application system under Category B, entering Agency No. 10006.
Step 5: Pay the Beihang University application processing fee of RMB 400 online.
Step 6: Departmental academic committee evaluates academic merit and conducts video interview via Zoom or Tencent Meeting (February - March).
Step 7: Beihang International School submits nominated candidate list to the China Scholarship Council (April - May).
Step 8: Final results published; official admission package (Admission Letter and JW201/JW202 form) sent to the student (July).
Step 9: Apply for Chinese X1 Student Visa in Pakistan and prepare for arrival in Beijing in September.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Direct University Nomination Track (Type B): Nominated directly by Beihang University to the CSC.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded as signed PDF documents on university letterhead with institutional email and telephone numbers.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Detailed Study Plan / Research Proposal covering academic background, research interests, experimental methodology, and career vision (minimum 1,000 words).
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Clear, technical proposal with specific objectives, engineering relevance, and timeline mapping directly to Beihang lab focus areas.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Curriculum Vitae detailing education, technical proficiencies, research publications, and academic awards.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical interview conducted by a panel of 3-4 faculty members covering technical fundamentals, research proposal defense, and English proficiency.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: Not required; English proficiency certificate or MOI letter mandatory.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degree certificates and transcripts must be notarized in Pakistan by a notary public; HEC and MoFA attestations needed for final enrollment.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: English or Chinese certified translations required for any non-English/non-Chinese records.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online digital submission on both Beihang and CSC systems.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Degrees must be from HEC-recognized Pakistani universities.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Minimum 1,000 words in English or Chinese outlining research methodology and objectives.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must demonstrate rigorous domain understanding and laboratory relevance.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must contain official institutional email addresses of Pakistani referees.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 30% (Undergraduate/Master's GPA and academic distinction)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Prior publications, engineering competition awards, and research plan quality)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Study plan depth, clarity of objectives, and institutional match)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Beihang International School Admissions Board, Departmental Academic Review Committee, and CSC Expert Panel.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Rigorous two-phase assessment: school-level academic screening followed by CSC national ratification.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~3,000 to 4,500 international applicants across all disciplines
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~100 to 150 full scholarships awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~6.0% among candidates holding official faculty acceptance letters
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.50+ / 4.00 or 80%+ aggregate from premier Pakistani engineering institutions (NUST, GIKI, PIEAS, IST, UET)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with solid engineering fundamentals, high-impact final year projects, and at least one Scopus-indexed research paper or conference presentation.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani aerospace, electrical, mechanical, and computer engineering universities.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Russia, Iran, Kazakhstan, Egypt, Thailand, Indonesia, Nigeria.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of unauthorized agents advertising guaranteed CSC seats at Beihang University for hefty fees.
All legitimate submissions take place exclusively via admission.buaa.edu.cn and studyinchina.csc.edu.cn.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Beihang University charges an official RMB 400 application fee; the CSC system charges no additional fee. Never wire funds to individual bank accounts.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Beihang University does not authorize any commercial recruiting agents for CSC scholarships; applications must be initiated directly by the student.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Beihang application fee: RMB 400.
Medical checkup, police certificate, and MoFA attestation: ~PKR 30,000 to 40,000.
One-way/round-trip flight from Pakistan to Beijing: ~PKR 170,000 to 230,000.
Initial settling-in expenses before first stipend disbursement: ~RMB 2,500; ~PKR 100,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You cannot study aerospace in China without speaking Chinese. Reality: Beihang offers extensive graduate programs delivered completely in English.
Myth: A professor's verbal email confirmation is equivalent to an acceptance letter. Reality: Only the signed, official Beihang Provisional Acceptance Form guarantees departmental nomination.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial portals claim paper documents must be couriered to Beijing; Beihang uses a paperless digital portal submission system.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a passing grade in all courses (minimum 70% or Grade B equivalent) and meet all milestone research requirements.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory classroom attendance and daily involvement in assigned laboratory research projects.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual CSC Comprehensive Evaluation conducted every May; satisfactory progress is mandatory for continuation of monthly stipend and fee waiver.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Off-campus employment is restricted under Chinese visa regulations without formal university authorization.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory return requirement; graduates may pursue post-doctoral research, international employment, or industry roles in China under proper work permits.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: No bond or return service agreement enforced.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminated immediately if the student is expelled for criminal offenses, university code violations, or unauthorized absence.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Transferring to another Chinese university under the CSC scholarship is strictly disallowed.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Major modifications are not permitted once admitted under the scholarship.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship extensions beyond the designated duration are rarely approved by CSC; students must fund remaining time via supervisor research assistantships.

basic_details.scholarship_name: Seoul National University (SNU) Global Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: Seoul National University (SNU) Office of International Affairs (OIA)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Seoul National University (Gwanak Main Campus and Yeongeon Medical Campus, Seoul, South Korea)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all graduate colleges: College of Engineering, College of Natural Sciences, College of Agriculture and Life Sciences, Graduate School of Data Science, College of Pharmacy, College of Medicine, College of Social Sciences, and Graduate School of International Studies (GSIS).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~160 to 200 graduate scholars supported per semester across Global Scholarship Category 1 (Tuition + Stipend) and Category 2 (Tuition Exemption)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international merit competition; Pakistani graduate researchers in STEM, computing, and life sciences secure ~10 to 18 awards per semester
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 1 year renewable (up to 2 years for Master's, 3 years for PhD) subject to maintaining a minimum semester GPA of 3.0 / 4.3

nationality_requirements: International applicants whose parents are not citizens of South Korea (Pakistan eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No formal age limit, but competitive applicants are typically under 35 (Master's) or under 40 (PhD).
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for Master's; recognized Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD from an HEC-recognized institution with distinguished academic performance (minimum 75% aggregate or CGPA 3.30 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.60+ / 4.00 or top 10% class rank).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Transcript grades evaluated on SNU 4.3 grading scale; applicants should hold an equivalent of B+ (3.3/4.3) or higher.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Prior degree closely aligned with the applied academic discipline.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Students in their final semester can apply conditionally with a bonafide letter from their university stating expected graduation date.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Research laboratory experience, coding proficiency, or published papers in international journals significantly enhance selection odds.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: TOEFL iBT min 80, IELTS Academic min 6.0, TEPS min 269, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from Pakistani university confirming undergraduate/master education was conducted in English.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Korean proficiency (TOPIK) is not required for English-track STEM programs; TOPIK Level 3+ recommended for Humanities and Social Sciences.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants can apply for the SNU Global Scholarship during the general international graduate admissions application window or upon admission.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot concurrently hold other full external government scholarships (e.g. GKS/KGSP).

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition fee waiver for the enrolled academic semester/year (KRW 3,200,000 to 6,100,000 / semester value depending on college).

admission_application_fee.details: SNU international graduate admissions application fee of KRW 90,000 (~USD 68; ~PKR 18,900) paid online via UwayApply.

accommodation.details: SNU Gwanak Residence Halls (Bldg 900-906) provided at highly subsidized student rates: KRW 200,000 to 350,000 / month (~USD 150 to 260 / month) for double/single rooms, easily covered from the monthly stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Global Scholarship Category 1 recipients receive a tax-free monthly living stipend of KRW 1,200,000 / month (~USD 900 / month; ~PKR 252,000 / month) for 12 months. Supplementary laboratory research assistantship (RA) stipends typically add KRW 600,000 to 1,000,000 / month.

airfare.details: Selected Global Scholarship 1 awardees receive a one-time economy round-trip or one-way flight subsidy (up to KRW 1,000,000; ~USD 750).

visa_fee.details: Korean D-2 Student Visa processing fees at the Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Islamabad are paid by the student.

health_insurance.details: Mandatory Korean National Health Insurance Service (NHIS) covers foreign students; subsidized monthly premium is ~KRW 70,000 / month, covered from the monthly living stipend.

food_allowance.details: SNU campus cafeterias (Student Center cafeteria, Dormitory cafeteria, and Halal-friendly meal options) provide wholesome meals for KRW 3,500 to 6,000 per meal; easily covered by the KRW 1,200,000 monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Comprehensive access to SNU Main Library, digital archives, supercomputing facilities, and advanced laboratory equipment.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Laboratory BK21 (Brain Korea 21 Four) funding and National Research Foundation of Korea (NRF) grants provide travel funding for international conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Seoul Metropolitan subway and bus transit (T-Money card) paid from monthly stipend (~KRW 60,000/month).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (Seoul National University)
participating_institutions: Seoul National University (SNU) - SKY University flagship (Seoul, South Korea)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #31 worldwide, Times Higher Education #62 globally, #1 in South Korea.
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master's: 2 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years; Combined MS-PhD: 4 to 5 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Online application via UwayApply, personal statement and study plan, two letters of recommendation, verified degree certificates and transcripts, language proficiency report (IELTS/TOEFL/MOI), passport copies of applicant and parents, and proof of family relations.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Admission to the Department of Computer Science and Engineering and Graduate School of Data Science is exceptionally competitive; having a prospective lab professor's preliminary support or joint research discussion dramatically improves funding prospects.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Review SNU faculty laboratory websites, read their recent publications in IEEE/Nature/ACM, and email the professor 1-2 months before the application cycle opens with your CV, transcript, and a concise summary of your research interest.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: SNU Graduate Admissions Portal & UwayApply
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an applicant account on UwayApply during the open application window, select Seoul National University Graduate International Admissions (Track 1), complete data entry, and check the scholarship application box for the SNU Global Scholarship.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Contact prospective SNU professors to discuss lab openings and research alignment (June - July for Spring, December - January for Fall).
Step 2: Create account on UwayApply and complete the SNU International Graduate Admissions form.
Step 3: Indicate interest and complete the application section for the SNU Global Scholarship.
Step 4: Pay the application fee of KRW 90,000 online via international credit card.
Step 5: Have academic recommenders submit online recommendation letters directly through the automated email system.
Step 6: Upload or courier certified documents (transcripts, degrees, apostille/consular confirmation, family relations proof).
Step 7: Departmental admissions committee reviews applications and conducts technical interviews via Zoom (September for Spring, April for Fall).
Step 8: Final admission and Global Scholarship results announced by SNU OIA (November for Spring, June for Fall).
Step 9: Receive Certificate of Admission (CoA), apply for Korean D-2 visa in Islamabad, and matriculate at SNU.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Application: Scholarship consideration is embedded directly within the SNU general graduate admissions process.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via the secure SNU recommendation portal link generated upon application fee payment.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Self-Introduction and Study Plan covering personal background, motivations for studying at SNU, undergraduate research achievements, and proposed graduate research project.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured plan detailing research problem, methodologies, expected academic contributions, and alignment with target SNU laboratory.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic CV highlighting academic honors, research papers, software projects, and technical skills.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online video interview via Zoom conducted by a 2-3 faculty member committee assessing domain knowledge, mathematical/analytical skills, and research drive.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: Not required; GRE is optional but strongly recommended for competitive STEM applicants.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts must be authenticated by HEC Pakistan, MoFA, and consular legalized by the Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Islamabad, or apostilled.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online application via UwayApply followed by submission of verified hardcopy credentials as instructed by the admissions office.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Proof of Nationality and Family Relations
required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned passport copies of applicant and parents, along with Family Registration Certificate (FRC).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: NADRA Family Registration Certificate (FRC) in English translated and attested by MoFA.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of applicant's passport valid for at least 1 year.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must have at least 18 months remaining validity.

important_dates_timeline.application_open_date: Early July (Spring Intake) / Early January (Fall Intake)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Two application intake cycles per academic year: Spring semester (starts March) and Fall semester (starts September).

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Undergraduate/Master's GPA and academic excellence)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Prior research, publications, and study plan alignment)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of purpose and articulation of goals)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: SNU Departmental Admissions Committee, Graduate School Academic Board, and Office of International Affairs (OIA) Scholarship Panel.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Comprehensive holistic review evaluating academic rigor, research potential, faculty fit, and international diversity.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~4,000 to 5,500 international applicants across both semesters
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~300 to 400 Global Scholarships awarded annually across both semesters
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~8.0% among competitive STEM applicants with supervisor backing
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.60+ / 4.00 or 85%+ aggregate from top Pakistani universities (NUST, FAST, QAU, GIKI, UET, LUMS)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with exceptional academic records, solid coding/lab skills, and at least 1-2 research publications or significant thesis project outcomes.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani premier science and engineering universities.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Vietnam, India, Indonesia, China, Turkey, USA, Germany.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of fraudulent websites offering admission guarantees or unofficial scholarship letters for Seoul National University.
Legitimate applications are processed ONLY through en.snu.ac.kr and uwayapply.com.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: SNU application fee is KRW 90,000 paid exclusively via UwayApply; no other agency fees are authorized.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: SNU does not work with third-party recruitment agencies; direct application is mandatory.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Application fee: KRW 90,000 (~PKR 18,900).
NADRA FRC, HEC attestation, MoFA attestation, and Korean Embassy legalization: ~PKR 40,000 to 55,000.
Mandatory Korean NHIS health insurance (~KRW 70,000/month) paid from stipend.
Round-trip airfare from Pakistan to Incheon/Seoul (~PKR 190,000 to 250,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You cannot study at SNU without speaking Korean. Reality: Nearly all graduate STEM courses and laboratory research are conducted entirely in English.
Myth: The scholarship covers all 4 years automatically. Reality: The award is renewed semester-by-semester based on maintaining a minimum GPA of 3.0 / 4.3.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial forums state that professor contact is not required; in practice, STEM applicants without prior professor contact rarely get allocated lab space or scholarship funding.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum semester GPA of 3.0 / 4.3 (Grade B equivalent) to retain the scholarship for subsequent semesters.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time academic standing and active daily laboratory research engagement.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-end academic record review by the Office of International Affairs (OIA) before releasing subsequent tuition waivers and stipends.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time work permitted up to 20 hours/week during semester with university and immigration permission, but full-time external employment is prohibited.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No obligation to return to Pakistan; graduates can transition to Korean D-10 job seeker visas or E-7 professional work visas.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: No bond or mandatory service agreement.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship cancelled if the student is subject to disciplinary action, withdraws without authorization, or fails to meet minimum GPA standards.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Transferring to another university results in immediate loss of SNU scholarship benefits.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing majors requires formal review and typically results in loss of the Global Scholarship funding.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Global Scholarship duration is strictly capped at standard program length (up to 4 semesters for Master's, 6-8 for PhD); subsequent extensions must be funded via lab RA/TA funds.

basic_details.scholarship_name: Nanyang Technological University (NTU) Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship (NPGS)
basic_details.offering_entity: Nanyang Technological University (NTU Singapore)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Nanyang Technological University (Jurong West Campus and Novena Campus, Singapore)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all doctoral research programs across College of Engineering (CCEB, CEE, EEE, MSE, MAE, SCSE), College of Science (SBS, SPMS, ASE), Nanyang Business School, and College of Humanities, Arts, and Social Sciences.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~30 to 45 highly prestigious NPGS awards globally per academic year
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani PhD scholars with stellar academic records and top-tier publications secure ~2 to 5 awards annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 4 years of doctoral research, subject to satisfactory annual research progress and passing the PhD qualifying examination

nationality_requirements: Open to outstanding scholars of all nationalities (Pakistan eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No formal age limit; evaluated purely on academic and research brilliance.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: First Class Honours degree or equivalent outstanding academic record (minimum CGPA 3.70 / 4.00 or 85%+ aggregate) in an appropriate undergraduate or research master's degree from a recognized institution.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Applicants must demonstrate graduating in the top 5% of their class.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering, physical sciences, computing, biological sciences, or quantitative social sciences.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating seniors in their final semester can apply conditionally with certified interim transcripts.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Substantial research experience, first-author journal publications (IEEE, Nature, ACM, Springer), or notable conference papers strongly emphasized.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Official English proficiency test report mandatory: TOEFL iBT minimum 100 or IELTS Academic minimum 6.5. GRE score is required for applicants from non-Singaporean institutions (minimum GRE Verbal + Quantitative score of 319, Analytical Writing 3.5), or GATE (score 90%+ percentile for engineering).
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and research conducted entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants apply for NPGS concurrently through the NTU PhD Graduate Admission portal.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold any concurrent scholarship, fellowship, or paid employment without NTU approval.

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition fee waiver for up to 4 years of doctoral study (SGD 22,000 to 39,000 / year value depending on discipline).

admission_application_fee.details: NTU graduate research application fee of SGD 54.50 (~USD 41; ~PKR 11,500) per program choice paid online.

accommodation.details: Priority on-campus graduate housing at NTU Graduate Halls (Hall 1, Hall 2, North Hill) for initial year: SGD 350 to 650 / month (~USD 260 to 480 / month), comfortably paid out of the substantial monthly stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Premium monthly tax-free living stipend: SGD 3,200 to SGD 3,500 / month prior to passing PhD Qualifying Examination (QE); increased to SGD 3,700 / month (~USD 2,750 / month; ~PKR 777,000 / month) upon successful confirmation/passing of QE.

airfare.details: One-time settling-in and travel allowance included as part of the initial onboarding grant package.

visa_fee.details: Singapore Student's Pass application and issuance fees (ICA) covered or reimbursed by university.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive NTU Medical Insurance Scheme for Graduate Students covering hospitalization, outpatient, and personal accident.

food_allowance.details: Over 20 dining food courts across NTU campus (including diverse Halal-certified options, North Indian, and Malay food stalls) provide meals for SGD 4 to 8 per meal; easily covered by the SGD 3,500/month stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Annual book and materials allowance of SGD 500 / year plus a one-time IT allowance of SGD 1,500 for laptop/hardware procurement.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Generous dedicated annual conference grant of up to SGD 4,000 / year (~USD 3,000 / year) to present peer-reviewed papers at leading international conferences globally.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Campus shuttle buses (Red, Blue, Green lines) are free; MRT and bus transit across Singapore paid out of stipend (~SGD 100/month).
travel_transit_allowance.amount: Free on-campus shuttles; MRT from stipend

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (Nanyang Technological University)
participating_institutions: Nanyang Technological University (NTU Singapore) - Main Campus (Jurong West, Singapore)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #15 worldwide, Times Higher Education #32 globally; #1 worldwide in Materials Science and Artificial Intelligence citations.
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 4 years (full-time PhD)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Online NTU application form, research proposal, academic transcripts, degree certificates, GRE and TOEFL/IELTS test score reports, two academic referee reports, CV, and sample publications/writing samples.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: NPGS is NTU's most selective flagship doctoral award; engineering and computer science receive extraordinary numbers of top applicants globally; having an engaged prospective NTU professor endorsing your proposal is decisive.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Thoroughly review prospective advisors' current research grants and recent publications. Formulate a 2-to-3 page research draft that aligns directly with their laboratory objectives before submitting your official application.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: NTU Graduate Online Application Portal (GOAP)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an applicant profile on NTU GOAP, select PhD by Research, choose the target academic school, and tick the box for 'Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship (NPGS)'.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Contact potential faculty supervisors at NTU with your academic CV and research proposal summary (August - October).
Step 2: Take GRE (min 319 V+Q) and TOEFL (min 100) or IELTS (min 6.5) and request official ETS/IELTS score reporting to NTU.
Step 3: Register on NTU GOAP, complete personal and educational history, and nominate two academic referees.
Step 4: Upload soft copies of transcripts, degree certificates, CV, research proposal, and passport.
Step 5: Pay the application fee of SGD 54.50 online via Visa/MasterCard.
Step 6: Referees submit appraisal reports through the online referee portal link sent automatically by NTU.
Step 7: School Shortlisting Committee and University Scholarship Selection Board review files and invite candidates for rigorous interviews (December - February).
Step 8: Final NPGS offer letters issued to selected awardees (March - April).
Step 9: Accept the fellowship offer, apply for Singapore Student's Pass via SOLAR system, and matriculate in August.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Application: Scholarship application is submitted directly through the NTU PhD graduate admission application form.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by academic referees via the automated NTU online recommendation system.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose outlining research motivations, academic trajectory, long-term scientific objectives, and alignment with NTU's research vision.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Rigorous 3 to 5-page doctoral research proposal detailing research hypothesis, theoretical framework, methodology, experimental design, and preliminary bibliography.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic curriculum vitae with comprehensive publication citations (including DOI and impact factor), awards, and technical competencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Rigorous 30 to 45-minute video interview conducted by an elite panel of NTU school chairs and university professors evaluating scientific rigor, intellectual independence, and leadership potential.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE mandatory for international graduates (min Verbal + Quantitative 319, Analytical Writing 3.5); TOEFL (min 100) or IELTS (min 6.5) mandatory.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts must be attested by HEC Pakistan and verified by the issuing universities; official English transcripts required.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations required for all non-English credentials.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via NTU GOAP portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Completed online PhD application form specifying NPGS consideration.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure high academic rigor; alignment with NTU faculty lab priorities is essential.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official ETS GRE score report with Verbal + Quantitative >= 319 and Analytical Writing >= 3.5.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 30% (Undergraduate/Master's GPA, First Class Honours, university standing)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Top-tier peer-reviewed publications, research proposal originality, and supervisor support)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 5% (Scientific vision and intellectual ambition)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 10% (Panel interview performance and defense of research proposal)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: NTU School Graduate Committee, College Chairs, and University Fellowship Selection Committee chaired by the Associate Provost.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-tiered ultra-competitive merit review focusing on peer-reviewed research outputs, supervisor sponsorship, and interview defense.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~2,500 to 3,500 elite global applicants specifically contending for NPGS
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~30 to 45 fellowships awarded university-wide annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2.0% to 3.0% among applicants possessing high GRE scores and published papers
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.80+ / 4.00 or top 2% class rank with First Class Honours from leading Pakistani institutions (NUST, GIKI, PIEAS, FAST, LUMS)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with exceptional academic records, GRE 320+, and multiple first-author papers in high-impact journals or top-tier IEEE/ACM conferences.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Top graduates of leading engineering and science universities worldwide.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Singapore, China, India, Pakistan, Vietnam, Germany, USA, UK.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of unsolicited emails offering guaranteed admission or scholarships to NTU Singapore.
Legitimate applications are processed ONLY through ntu.edu.sg and venus.wis.ntu.edu.sg.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: NTU charges an official non-refundable application fee of SGD 54.50 paid securely via GOAP portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: NTU does not engage commercial agencies for doctoral scholarship selections; all applications must be directly submitted by the applicant.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Application fee: SGD 54.50 (~PKR 11,500).
GRE examination fee: ~USD 220 (~PKR 62,000) and TOEFL/IELTS fee: ~PKR 60,000.
Singapore Student's Pass processing and issuance fees: ~SGD 90 (~PKR 19,000).
Round-trip airfare from Pakistan to Singapore Changi: ~PKR 160,000 to 220,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: GRE is optional for international applicants. Reality: Non-graduates of Singapore autonomous universities MUST submit official GRE scores.
Myth: An NTU professor can directly award the NPGS. Reality: Professors can nominate, but final award decisions are made by the University Fellowship Selection Committee.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some student forums claim GRE waivers are easy to obtain; for NPGS, GRE is strictly required and non-negotiable for foreign degree holders.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.50 / 5.00 throughout doctoral candidature and pass the PhD Qualifying Examination (QE) within 18 months.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time campus research commitment; active participation in lab seminars, departmental colloquia, and teaching assistantships (TA) as required.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual progress reporting and annual review by the doctoral supervisory committee; unsatisfactory progress leads to fellowship termination.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may not engage in external paid employment or commercial consulting during the scholarship period without explicit approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory return requirement; graduates are free to pursue post-doctoral fellowships, academia, or high-tech industry careers in Singapore or globally.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: No bond attached to the NPGS scholarship (unlike the Singapore MOE Tuition Grant for undergraduates/masters).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Fellowship terminated if student withdraws without justification or is dismissed for disciplinary misconduct or academic dishonesty.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Major/school changes require approval by both academic school chairs and the Associate Provost.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: NPGS funding terminates strictly after 4 years (48 months); any thesis completion beyond year 4 must be funded through laboratory project funds.

basic_details.scholarship_name: Taibah University International Student Scholarship (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.offering_entity: Ministry of Education of Saudi Arabia & Taibah University
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Taibah University Main Campus (Medina Al-Munawwarah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to Islamic Studies, Arabic Language and Literature, Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, and Business Administration (Health/Medical clinical colleges reserved for Saudi nationals under national policy).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~250 to 350 external international government scholarships allocated annually across all faculties
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Generous bilateral quota; Pakistani students constitute one of the most prominent international student communities in Medina (~35 to 55 scholarships annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 to 5 years for Bachelor's; 2 to 3 years for Master's; 3 to 4 years for PhD (plus 1-year Arabic language preparatory institute if required)

nationality_requirements: International applicants holding non-Saudi citizenship (Pakistan eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate applicants must be between 17 and 25 years old; Master's applicants under 30; PhD applicants under 35 years of age.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: HSSC / Intermediate (Pre-Engineering, Pre-Medical, or ICS) or A-Levels for Bachelor's (minimum 80% marks or Grade B); recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree for Master's; 18-year Master's degree for PhD from an HEC-recognized institution with a minimum CGPA of 3.00 / 4.00 or Very Good (Jayyid Jiddan) standing.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Transcript grades evaluated on Saudi 5.0 scale (minimum 3.75 / 5.00 equivalent).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Pre-Engineering or ICS for Computer Science and Engineering; Pre-Medical or General Science for Natural Sciences.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Applicants must have completed their requisite qualification and possess official final transcripts/certificates at the time of portal registration.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: High school diploma must not be older than 3 to 5 years from the date of application.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; research publications or teaching assistantships beneficial for postgraduate candidates.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Instruction in STEM faculties is primarily in English (MOI certificate accepted; IELTS 5.5+ or TOEFL 65 recommended). For Sharia and Arabic faculties, candidates must demonstrate Arabic competence or complete the university's intensive 1-year Arabic Institute.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Arabic Institute placement exam conducted upon campus arrival for non-Arabic speakers.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Female students must reside with an approved Mahram residing legally in Saudi Arabia or within monitored university female student dormitories with institutional guardianship approval.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applications are submitted through the unified Saudi government portal 'Study in Saudi' (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa).
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Applicant must not have been previously awarded a Saudi government scholarship and dismissed or graduated from another Saudi university.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee exemption for the entire official duration of academic study.
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~SAR 25,000 to 40,000 / year value; ~PKR 1,875,000 to 3,000,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: Application through the official 'Study in Saudi' portal is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free furnished on-campus student housing in Taibah University residential dormitories in Medina, including utilities, high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and laundry facilities.

monthly_stipend.details: Tax-free monthly living stipend disbursed directly into student bank accounts: SAR 840 / month for undergraduate students (~USD 224; ~PKR 63,000 / month); SAR 900 to 1,000 / month for postgraduate students (~USD 240 to 266; ~PKR 67,500 to 75,000 / month).

airfare.details: Free annual economy-class round-trip flight ticket between Pakistan and Prince Mohammad bin Abdulaziz International Airport (Medina) provided by the university at the end of each academic year.

visa_fee.details: Saudi governmental study visa issued free of charge through the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in Islamabad or Royal Consulate in Karachi.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive 100% free medical and dental healthcare provided at Taibah University Medical Center and King Fahd Hospital Medina.

food_allowance.details: Heavily subsidized campus dining halls provide balanced multi-course meals for SAR 3 to 6 per meal; easily covered by the monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Free textbook issuance and full borrowing privileges at the Central University Library; initial book allowance provided upon enrollment.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Thesis printing allowance (SAR 3,000 for Master's, SAR 4,000 for PhD) and financial incentives for publishing in Web of Science / Scopus Q1 journals.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free university shuttle bus service operating daily between dormitories, university faculties, and the Prophet's Mosque (Al-Masjid an-Nabawi).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (Taibah University, Medina)
participating_institutions: Taibah University Main Campus (Medina Al-Munawwarah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS Arab Region #61-70, Times Higher Education Asia #201-250, accredited by the National Center for Academic Accreditation and Assessment (NCAAA).
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Bachelor's: 4 to 5 years; Master's: 2 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Unified online application via 'Study in Saudi' platform, high school / bachelor's diploma with minimum 80% marks, attested transcripts, medical fitness certificate, clean police conduct certificate, two academic recommendation letters, and valid passport copy.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Islamic Studies and Computer Science receive intense global demand due to Medina's religious significance; high academic grades (85%+) and solid recommendations are essential for admission.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Ensure all Pakistani educational certificates are fully attested by IBCC/HEC and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) before submitting to avoid portal disqualification.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Study in Saudi Official Portal (Ministry of Education, KSA)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an account on 'Study in Saudi' portal, choose 'External Scholarship (منحة خارجية)', select Taibah University as the preferred institution, select degree level, and upload attested digital scans.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check application announcement on the 'Study in Saudi' portal (typically opens September/October).
Step 2: Create profile, fill in personal details, and enter academic percentages and grading scales.
Step 3: Upload color scans of passport, educational degrees, transcripts, medical fitness certificate, and police clearance.
Step 4: Select Taibah University and choose top 3 preferred academic disciplines.
Step 5: Submit application online (no application fee required) and note the tracking number.
Step 6: Taibah University Admissions Committee screens applications and nominates candidates to the Saudi Ministry of Education (December - March).
Step 7: Final security clearance and Ministry approval granted (May - July).
Step 8: Official admission letter and Saudi visa authorization number issued via the portal.
Step 9: Complete Saudi Student Visa stamping at Gerry's / Etimad visa center in Islamabad/Karachi, receive free flight ticket, and arrive in Medina in September.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Unified Platform Track: Application through 'Study in Saudi' automatically includes admission and full government scholarship.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded as scanned PDF documents signed by teachers/professors on official school/university letterhead.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose outlining academic achievements, reasons for choosing Taibah University and the city of Medina, and post-graduation goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: For Master's/PhD applicants: 3 to 5-page research proposal detailing proposed topic, methodology, and relevance.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard curriculum vitae detailing educational history, academic honors, and community service.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Generally no oral interview; selection is determined entirely on academic document review and Ministry security vetting.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: None strictly required; GAT/Qudurat not required for international external applicants.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts must be attested by IBCC (for Intermediate) or HEC (for degrees), MoFA Pakistan, and the Saudi Cultural Mission / Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in Islamabad.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified Arabic or English translation required for documents not issued in English or Arabic.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission through studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned color copies of Matric/Intermediate (for Undergrad) or Bachelor's/Master's (for Postgrad) certificates.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be attested by IBCC / HEC and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned information page of ordinary passport valid for at least 18 months.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must be valid through late 2027 or 2028.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Conducted at a recognized diagnostic laboratory and attested by MoFA.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Recent certificate of good conduct issued by police authorities within the last 6 months.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Obtained from Police Khidmat Markaz and attested by MoFA.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued on official school/college letterhead with contact details.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: NADRA computerized certificate attested by MoFA.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual intake cycle coordinated via the central Saudi 'Study in Saudi' portal for September fall semester enrollment.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (For postgraduates: thesis and research publications)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of purpose and motivations)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Taibah University International Student Deanship and Ministry of Education Scholarship Review Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-stage evaluation: academic merit ranking by university departments followed by security clearance by the Saudi Ministry of Interior and Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~12,000 to 18,000 applicants globally on Study in Saudi portal for Taibah University
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~250 to 350 scholarships awarded annually across all levels
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~3.5% to 5.0% for applicants meeting top academic criteria (85%+ marks)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 85%+ in Intermediate (FSc/ICS) or CGPA 3.40+ / 4.00 from an HEC-recognized university
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Outstanding academic record, impeccable discipline, clean legal record, and strong commitment to completing studies in Medina.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Students from reputable colleges across Punjab, Sindh, KPK, and federal Islamabad.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Indonesia, Nigeria, Egypt, Yemen, Malaysia, Bangladesh, India.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of fraudulent agents charging money promising guaranteed Saudi government scholarships to Medina.
Legitimate applications are processed ONLY through studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa and the official Taibah University website. Neither the university nor the Saudi government charges any fees.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying for Saudi government scholarships is 100% free; never pay an intermediary.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: The Ministry of Education strictly prohibits dealing with third-party brokers or educational agents.
hidden_costs_breakdown: IBCC, HEC, and MoFA degree attestation fees in Pakistan (~PKR 15,000 to 25,000).
Saudi Cultural Mission / Embassy consular attestation and Gerry's/Etimad visa fingerprinting: ~PKR 20,000 to 30,000.
Medical screening tests at authorized GAMCA / approved diagnostic center: ~PKR 12,000 to 18,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You must already be fluent in Arabic to study engineering or computing in Saudi Arabia. Reality: STEM subjects are taught in English; free Arabic courses are provided for daily life.
Myth: External scholarships allow candidates to sponsor work visas for family members. Reality: Student visa holders cannot sponsor work permits for relatives.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Social media posts claim direct paper submissions to the university in Medina; only digital applications through the 'Study in Saudi' portal are processed.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.75 / 5.00 (Good standing); failure leads to academic probation and suspension of monthly stipend if uncorrected.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory classroom attendance of at least 75%; unexcused absence results in course failure (Denial/Hirman).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-end academic audit conducted by the Deanship of Admissions; students must complete the degree within the approved statutory duration.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Off-campus employment is strictly prohibited under Saudi student visa regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Upon graduation, students must depart the Kingdom within the designated exit grace period unless approved for postgraduate study or authorized employment transition.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: No financial bond or return service agreement enforced.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship terminated immediately for serious disciplinary infractions, violations of public order, or unexcused university abandonment.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Transferring to another Saudi university is extremely difficult and requires explicit Ministry of Education approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Major change permitted only within the same faculty during the first academic year subject to departmental capacity and GPA criteria.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum extension of one additional semester permitted upon recommendation of the faculty council.

basic_details.scholarship_name: New York University Abu Dhabi (NYUAD) Global Leaders Fellowship & Financial Aid
basic_details.offering_entity: New York University Abu Dhabi (NYUAD) & Abu Dhabi Department of Education and Knowledge (ADEK)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: New York University Abu Dhabi (Saadiyat Island Campus, Abu Dhabi, UAE)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all 26 undergraduate majors across Engineering (Computer, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, General), Science (Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Psychology), Social Sciences (Economics, Political Science, SRPP), and Arts & Humanities.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~400 to 500 undergraduate scholars supported annually with comprehensive need-based institutional fellowship awards
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Extremely prestigious cohort; Pakistani high school scholars secure ~15 to 25 full fellowship awards annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 years of full-time undergraduate study, including 2 study-abroad semesters within NYU's global network (New York, Paris, London, Tokyo, etc.)

nationality_requirements: Open to outstanding students of all nationalities globally (Pakistan eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No formal age limit; applicants are typically graduating high school seniors or gap year students.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: High school diploma / Intermediate (FSc/ICS) with 90%+ marks, or A-Levels with minimum AAA / A*AA grades, or International Baccalaureate (IB) 38+ points. Class rank typically in the top 1-2%.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Holistic review of high school transcript (Grades 9-12); unweighted GPA equivalent of 3.8+ / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Rigorous coursework in mathematics, natural sciences, and humanities.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: High school seniors in their final year can apply with predicted grades; gap year students eligible.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Extraordinary extracurricular leadership, Olympiad awards, debate championships, or social impact initiatives strongly emphasized.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: TOEFL iBT min 100, IELTS Academic min 7.5, Duolingo English Test (DET) min 130, or Cambridge English C1/C2. English proficiency waiver available if applicant's secondary education was entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction is entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Fellowship is awarded based on demonstrated financial need (CSS Profile) combined with academic and leadership excellence; NYUAD meets 100% of demonstrated financial need.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: None.

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition fee waiver for the complete 4-year undergraduate degree (~USD 60,000 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: Common Application fee of USD 80 can be waived via Common App Fee Waiver for students demonstrating financial need.

accommodation.details: 100% covered modern single/double student residential housing on Saadiyat Island Campus (~USD 12,000 / year value), including utilities, Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and cleaning.

monthly_stipend.details: Comprehensive personal allowance and campus life stipend of ~AED 1,500 to 2,500 / month (~USD 400 to 680 / month; ~PKR 112,000 to 190,000 / month) to cover books, local transport, and miscellaneous personal expenses.

airfare.details: Two economy-class round-trip flights per academic year between Pakistan and Abu Dhabi, plus fully covered airfare and accommodations for January Term (J-Term) global study courses worldwide.

visa_fee.details: UAE Student Residence Visa application, medical fitness screening, and Emirates ID fees fully sponsored and managed by NYUAD.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive worldwide international health insurance policy (Abu Dhabi National Insurance Company - ADNIC) covering inpatient, outpatient, emergency medical evacuation, and dental/vision.

food_allowance.details: Full university meal plan (Falcon Dinar dining plan) covering 3 full meals per day across campus dining halls, cafes, and halal dining venues (~USD 6,000 / year value).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Dedicated course materials allowance and lab supply grant (~USD 1,000 / year) plus high-spec engineering laptop loan/issuance.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Summer research grants (up to USD 4,000), Capstone project funding, and undergraduate conference presentation travel grants.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to USD 4,000 summer research grant

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free university shuttles connecting Saadiyat Island Campus to downtown Abu Dhabi, malls, and cultural districts.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single portal university with global rotation (NYU Abu Dhabi + NYU Global Network)
participating_institutions: New York University Abu Dhabi (Saadiyat Island Campus, Abu Dhabi, UAE)
NYU Washington Square (New York City, USA)
NYU Global Academic Centers (London, Paris, Berlin, Madrid, Florence, Buenos Aires, Sydney, Accra)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: NYU ranked #38 QS World University Rankings, #32 Times Higher Education, #16 US News Global. NYUAD degrees are awarded directly by New York University.
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 4 years (full-time undergraduate)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Common Application submission, NYU-specific supplement, high school transcripts (Grades 9-12), counselor recommendation, two teacher recommendations, SAT/ACT (optional), English proficiency test (TOEFL/IELTS/DET), and CSS Profile for financial aid.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: NYUAD is one of the most selective undergraduate institutions on earth (acceptance rate ~3-4%); shortlisted finalists are flown all-expenses-paid to Abu Dhabi for the renowned 'Candidate Weekend' before final admission offers are rendered.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus heavily on unique intellectual curiosity and global citizenship in the Common App essays. If NYUAD is your unequivocal first choice, applying Early Decision (ED1 or ED2) significantly maximizes admission probability.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: The Common Application & College Board CSS Profile
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create account on Common App, add New York University, select Abu Dhabi campus as primary campus of interest, and complete the CSS Profile on cssprofile.collegeboard.org.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Complete Common Application profile, activities list, personal essay, and NYU-specific essay prompts (August - October).
Step 2: Submit official secondary school transcripts (Grades 9-11 and Grade 12 first-term / predicted grades) via school counselor.
Step 3: Have academic teachers submit two detailed recommendation letters.
Step 4: Complete and submit the CSS Profile for financial aid, uploading parent income tax returns and salary certificates to IDOC.
Step 5: Submit application by deadline: Early Decision 1 (Nov 1), Early Decision 2 (Jan 1), or Regular Decision (Jan 5).
Step 6: Selected semifinalists receive invitations to NYUAD 'Candidate Weekend' (all-expenses-paid visit to Abu Dhabi or virtual immersive experience).
Step 7: Admissions committee renders final admission and comprehensive fellowship package (mid-December for ED1, mid-February for ED2, late March for RD).
Step 8: Sign enrollment agreement, submit visa documentation to NYUAD Student Mobility Office.
Step 9: Arrive in Abu Dhabi in late August for the international student orientation program (Marhaba Week).
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Track: Admission automatically qualifies students for 100% need-met financial aid via the CSS Profile.
