basic_details.scholarship_name: Universiti Tenaga Nasional (UNITEN) Postgraduate Excellence Award & BOLD Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: Universiti Tenaga Nasional (UNITEN - The Energy University) & Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Universiti Tenaga Nasional Putrajaya Campus (Kajang, Selangor, Malaysia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: College of Computing and Informatics (CCI) & College of Engineering: Artificial Intelligence, Smart Energy Grids, Cybersecurity, Internet of Things, Cloud Computing, Renewable Energy Informatics, and Power Engineering.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~60 to 90 BOLD Postgraduate Excellence Scholarships and Graduate Research Assistantships awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international merit competition; Pakistani graduate researchers in computing and smart grid engineering secure ~8 to 14 awards annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for Master's; up to 3 to 4 years for PhD, subject to satisfactory semester research progress evaluations
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: MYR 1,800 to MYR 2,800 / month living stipend (~PKR 115,000 - 182,000 / month)

nationality_requirements: Open to international students of all nationalities (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Applicants must generally be under 35 years old at the time of application.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) with minimum CGPA 3.30 / 4.00 for Master's; recognized MS/MPhil (18 years education) with minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00 for PhD from an HEC-recognized university in Pakistan.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum grade equivalent of Grade B+ or CGPA 3.30 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Rigorous undergraduate preparation in computer science, software engineering, or electrical engineering.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating seniors or Master's students in their final semester can apply conditionally with expected graduation transcripts.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior software development projects, hackathon achievements, or published research papers are advantageous.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.0, TOEFL iBT minimum 79, or institutional English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from an accredited Pakistani university.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; postgraduate research and coursework are conducted 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must identify a prospective supervisor at UNITEN CCI and obtain preliminary consent.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another full national or university scholarship simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee and academic examination fee waiver at Universiti Tenaga Nasional covered by the BOLD scholarship or TNB research grant.

admission_application_fee.details: UNITEN international postgraduate application fee (~MYR 250 / USD 60) paid online via the portal.

accommodation.details: On-campus student residential apartments (Amanah / Cendekiawan) at UNITEN Putrajaya Campus; monthly rent is paid from the monthly living allowance.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living stipend: MYR 1,800 to MYR 2,300 per month for Master's; MYR 2,300 to MYR 2,800 per month for PhD (~PKR 115,000 - 182,000 / month; MYR 21,600 - 33,600 / year).

airfare.details: International airfare to Malaysia arranged by student; living allowance easily accommodates local savings.

visa_fee.details: EMGS visa approval letter (VAL) and Student Pass fees (~MYR 2,000 total) covered from stipend or research grant.

health_insurance.details: Mandatory Malaysian student health and hospitalization insurance included within the EMGS Student Pass package.

food_allowance.details: Covered via the monthly living stipend of MYR 1,800 - 2,800; campus cafeterias provide affordable halal meals.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to UNITEN Library, smart grid computing laboratories, GPU clusters, and software development platforms.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Departmental research funding available through supervisor's TNB research grants for publishing in indexed journals.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to MYR 3,500 for conference attendance

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free UNITEN campus shuttle bus service operating across all academic buildings and linking to nearby commuter train stations.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single premier energy and technological university: Universiti Tenaga Nasional (UNITEN).
participating_institutions: Universiti Tenaga Nasional Putrajaya Campus (Kajang, Selangor, Malaysia)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 150 in Asia (QS Asia University Rankings), renowned as Malaysia's premier specialized Energy University operated by Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB).
available_majors: Master / PhD in Information Technology (Artificial Intelligence)
Master / PhD in Information Technology (Cybersecurity & Smart Grids)
Master / PhD in Information Technology (Data Science & IoT)
Master / PhD in Electrical Engineering and Renewable Energy Systems
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 2 years for Master's; 3 to 4 years for PhD
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree (minimum CGPA 3.3/4.0) for Master's; Master's degree (minimum CGPA 3.5/4.0) for PhD, supervisor consent, research proposal, two recommendation letters, and English proficiency.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: UNITEN CCI AI and Smart Energy Grid laboratories have generous corporate and MOHE funding; reaching out to supervisors with active research grants is the primary path to guaranteed funding.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Browse the UNITEN College of Computing and Informatics directory (uniten.edu.my/cci), identify matching research groups in AI/software, and email prospective professors attaching your CV and a 2-page research proposal before applying on the UNITEN postgraduate portal.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: UNITEN Online Postgraduate Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Identify prospective supervisor on UNITEN portal, secure consent, register an applicant account on UNITEN Apply, submit degree application, and apply for the BOLD scholarship scheme.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore faculty research profiles on UNITEN CCI portal (https://www.uniten.edu.my/cci/).
Step 2: Email prospective supervisor with academic transcripts, CV, and a 2-page research proposal to secure consent.
Step 3: Register and apply online for postgraduate admission on the UNITEN Apply portal (https://apply.uniten.edu.my/).
Step 4: Upload attested transcripts, degrees, research proposal, CV, and reference letters.
Step 5: Apply for BOLD Postgraduate Scholarship scheme through the supervisor's endorsement.
Step 6: Attend faculty technical interview via Zoom if required.
Step 7: Receive official offer letter and fellowship award, then initiate the EMGS visa approval letter (VAL) process.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Supervisor Track: Admission and funding are processed jointly through the supervising faculty.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted on institutional letterhead signed by former academic professors or research supervisors.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of academic purpose detailing research accomplishments, technical capabilities, and postgraduate research vision.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured 2 to 4-page research proposal detailing background, problem statement, research methodology, and expected timeline.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic CV highlighting technical projects, publications, programming proficiencies, and awards.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 30-minute technical interview via Zoom conducted by prospective supervisor and faculty panel.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (min 6.0), TOEFL iBT (min 79), or institutional English MOI letter accepted; GRE not required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts attested by HEC and MOFA Pakistan; Matric/Inter by IBCC.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation required for all official documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via UNITEN Apply admissions portal.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts for 16-year Bachelor's (for MSc) or 18-year Master's (for PhD) with minimum CGPA 3.3/4.0.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested copies from HEC and MOFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 2 to 4-page structured proposal outlining problem statement, methodology, and timeline.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be aligned with UNITEN supervisor's funded research area.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Letter or email confirmation from an eligible UNITEN professor agreeing to supervise.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Obtained directly through academic correspondence.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential academic evaluations from previous professors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Printed on official university letterhead.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic (min 6.0), TOEFL iBT (min 79), or institutional English MOI letter.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: MOI letter signed by university registrar.

required_documents_checklist.specification: High-resolution color scan of all passport pages valid for at least 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must have validity through late 2028.

important_dates_timeline.application_open_date: Open year-round (Semester 1 intake opens March / Semester 2 opens September)
important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: June 30 (for October intake) / November 30 (for March intake)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Admissions operate on two semester intakes: Semester 1 (October) and Semester 2 (March). Applying 3-4 months in advance is recommended.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Previous degree GPA, minimum 3.30/4.00 requirement)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Quality of research proposal, technical project portfolio, and supervisor match)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of purpose and postgraduate research vision)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 0% (Interview performance factored directly into supervisor endorsement)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: UNITEN College of Graduate Studies and College of Computing Postgraduate Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase evaluation: supervisor nomination followed by faculty board academic review.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~600 to 900 international applicants for UNITEN postgraduate programs
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~60 to 90 graduate research scholarships awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~12% to 16% among candidates with supervisor consent
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: CGPA 3.40+ / 4.00 from top Pakistani engineering institutions (NUST, FAST, GIKI, UET, NED)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates of accredited computing and engineering faculties with solid programming foundations and practical capstone projects.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani computer science, software engineering, and electrical engineering faculties.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nigeria, Indonesia, India, Yemen, Sudan.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of educational agents claiming to provide 'guaranteed UNITEN admissions or scholarship awards'.
Applications are handled exclusively via the official UNITEN Apply portal (https://apply.uniten.edu.my/).
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: UNITEN application fee is MYR 250 paid directly on the portal; never transfer funds to personal bank accounts.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Universiti Tenaga Nasional does not work with third-party agents for research degree admissions.
hidden_costs_breakdown: UNITEN application fee: MYR 250 (~PKR 16,000).
EMGS visa approval letter (VAL) and medical fee: ~MYR 2,000 (~PKR 130,000).
Attestations in Pakistan: ~PKR 25,000.
Initial pocket money before first stipend transfer: ~MYR 1,500 (~PKR 98,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You can apply without a supervisor. Reality: Research Master's and PhD applications at UNITEN require prior engagement and consent from a qualified supervisor.
Myth: Language of instruction is Malay. Reality: UNITEN postgraduate STEM programs are researched, written, and defended 100% in English.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial websites state IELTS 6.5 is mandatory; UNITEN requires IELTS 6.0 or institutional English MOI letter for computing degrees.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory research progress (Progress Report Grade Satisfactory) each semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research attendance in the faculty research lab at UNITEN Putrajaya.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual progress reports evaluated by the Faculty Supervisory Committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: GRA recipients may be assigned teaching assistantship or grading duties (up to 6 hours/week) within the faculty.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No return obligation; graduates are free to pursue postdocs or careers in Malaysia or worldwide.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Publication milestone obligation: must publish at least 1-2 papers in indexed journals prior to thesis submission.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding cancelled if the candidate fails progress evaluations twice or withdraws without approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Non-transferable to other universities; tied specifically to Universiti Tenaga Nasional.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from both current and prospective supervisors and the Faculty Postgraduate Committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship is granted for standard duration (2 years for Master's; 3-4 years for PhD).

UNITEN Online Application Portal

basic_details.scholarship_name: King Khalid University International Student Scholarship (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.offering_entity: Ministry of Education of Saudi Arabia & King Khalid University (KKU)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: King Khalid University Main Campus (Abha & Al-Fara'a Campuses, Asir Province, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: College of Computer Science, College of Engineering, College of Science, College of Business, and College of Sharia (Health/Medical clinical colleges reserved exclusively for Saudi nationals under national policy).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~250 to 350 external international government scholarships allocated annually across faculties
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Extremely generous bilateral allocation; Pakistani students represent one of the largest international communities in Asir Province (~35 to 55 scholarships annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 to 5 years for Bachelor's; 2 years for Master's; 3 to 4 years for PhD (plus 1-year Arabic language preparatory institute if required)
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: SAR 840 / month for undergraduate students (~PKR 63,000 / month); SAR 900 - 1,000 / month for postgraduate students (~PKR 67,500 - 75,000 / month)

nationality_requirements: International applicants holding non-Saudi citizenship (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate applicants must be between 17 and 25 years old; Master's applicants under 30; PhD applicants under 35 years of age.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: HSSC / Intermediate (Pre-Engineering, Pre-Medical, or ICS) or A-Levels for Bachelor's (minimum 80% marks or Grade B); recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree for Master's; 18-year Master's degree for PhD from an HEC-recognized institution with a minimum CGPA of 3.00 / 4.00 or Very Good (Jayyid Jiddan) standing.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Transcript grades evaluated on Saudi 5.0 scale (minimum 3.75 / 5.00 equivalent).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Pre-Engineering or ICS for Computer Science and Engineering; Pre-Medical or General Science for Natural Sciences.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Applicants must have completed their requisite qualification and possess official final transcripts/certificates at the time of portal registration.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: High school diploma must not be older than 3 to 5 years from the date of application.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; research publications or teaching assistantships beneficial for postgraduate candidates.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Instruction in STEM faculties is primarily in English (MOI certificate accepted; IELTS 5.5+ or TOEFL 65 recommended). For Sharia and Arabic faculties, candidates must demonstrate Arabic competence or complete the university's intensive 1-year Arabic Institute.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Arabic Institute placement exam conducted upon campus arrival for non-Arabic speakers.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Female students must reside with an approved Mahram residing legally in Saudi Arabia or within monitored university female student dormitories with institutional guardianship approval.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applications are submitted through the unified Saudi government portal 'Study in Saudi' (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa).
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Applicant must not have been previously awarded a Saudi government scholarship and dismissed or graduated from another Saudi university.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee exemption for the entire official duration of academic study at King Khalid University.
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~SAR 25,000 to 40,000 / year value; ~PKR 1,875,000 to 3,000,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: Application through the official 'Study in Saudi' portal is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free furnished on-campus student housing in King Khalid University residential dormitories in Abha, including utilities, high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and laundry facilities.

monthly_stipend.details: Tax-free monthly living stipend disbursed directly into student bank accounts: SAR 840 / month for undergraduate students (~PKR 63,000 / month); SAR 900 to 1,000 / month for postgraduate students (~PKR 67,500 to 75,000 / month).

airfare.details: Free annual economy-class round-trip flight ticket between Pakistan and Abha International Airport (AHB) provided by the university at the end of each academic year.

visa_fee.details: Saudi governmental study visa issued free of charge through the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in Islamabad or Royal Consulate in Karachi.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive 100% free medical and dental healthcare provided at King Khalid University Medical City and government hospitals in Asir.

food_allowance.details: Heavily subsidized campus dining halls provide balanced multi-course meals for SAR 3 to 6 per meal; easily covered by the monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Free textbook issuance and full borrowing privileges at the Central University Library; initial book allowance provided upon enrollment.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Thesis printing allowance (SAR 3,000 for Master's, SAR 4,000 for PhD) and financial incentives for publishing in Web of Science / Scopus Q1 journals.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free university shuttle bus service operating daily between dormitories, university faculties, and city centers in Abha and Khamis Mushait.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single comprehensive host university (King Khalid University, Abha).
participating_institutions: King Khalid University (Al-Fara'a & Abha Campuses, Asir Province, Saudi Arabia)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS Arab Region #35-40, Times Higher Education Asia #150-200, accredited by the National Center for Academic Accreditation and Assessment (NCAAA).
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Bachelor's: 4 to 5 years; Master's: 2 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Unified online application via 'Study in Saudi' platform, high school / bachelor's diploma with minimum 80% marks, attested transcripts, medical fitness certificate, clean police conduct certificate, two academic recommendation letters, and valid passport copy.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Computer Science and Sharia faculties receive intense global demand; high academic marks (85%+) and solid recommendations are essential for admission.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Ensure all Pakistani educational certificates are fully attested by IBCC/HEC and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) before submitting on Study in Saudi portal to avoid system disqualification.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Study in Saudi Official Portal (Ministry of Education, KSA)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an account on 'Study in Saudi' portal, choose 'External Scholarship (منحة خارجية)', select King Khalid University as the preferred institution, select degree level, and upload attested digital scans.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Get matric/intermediate/degrees attested by IBCC/HEC and MoFA Pakistan.
Step 2: Obtain clean police character clearance certificate and official medical fitness report.
Step 3: Register an account on the 'Study in Saudi' portal (https://studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa/).
Step 4: Select King Khalid University, chosen academic major, and upload digital document copies.
Step 5: University admissions committee reviews credentials and nominates eligible candidates to the Ministry of Education.
Step 6: Ministry of Foreign Affairs issues electronic visa authorization number (Visa Slip).
Step 7: Submit passport to Saudi Embassy Islamabad or Consulate Karachi via authorized Etimad/Tashkeel visa centers; university issues free e-ticket.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Government Track: Single submission via 'Study in Saudi' handles both institutional admission and scholarship award.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly to the portal as attested PDFs with official institutional stamps.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of academic purpose and career objectives in Saudi Arabia (Arabic or English).
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: For Master's/PhD: 2 to 3-page research proposal outlining the intended thesis domain.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard professional CV detailing educational background, academic percentages, and technical skills.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Screening is primarily based on academic grades, attestation verification, and security clearance.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS/TOEFL recommended for STEM disciplines; not mandatory if medium of instruction was English.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: IBCC (for Matric/Inter), HEC (for Bachelor's/Master's), and MoFA Pakistan attestations mandatory.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified Arabic or English translation of all academic records and police certificates.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online submission via Study in Saudi platform.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Matric/Inter/Bachelor's degrees with minimum 80% aggregate marks.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by IBCC/HEC and MoFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official police certificate verifying no criminal record.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by local police department and attested by MoFA.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Comprehensive medical checkup confirming freedom from contagious diseases (HIV, Hep B/C, TB).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by an authorized medical diagnostic laboratory.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color scan of passport bio page valid for at least 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must have validity extending through late 2028.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Letters from former teachers/professors attesting to character and competence.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Printed on official institutional letterhead.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Saudi external scholarship cycles open annually between May and July. Ministry approvals and visa issuance can take 4-6 months.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 60% (Academic percentage in high school or university transcripts)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (For postgraduate applicants: research proposal and publications)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 0% (Not required for undergraduate or master's degrees)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Motivation letter clarity and intent)
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: 0% (Pure academic merit and bilateral country quota)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Deanship of Admission and Registration at King Khalid University and Saudi Ministry of Education Evaluation Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Point-based merit ranking based on attested transcript marks, document verification, and national quota allocation.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~15,000 to 25,000 international applicants across Study in Saudi portal
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~250 to 350 scholarships awarded at KKU annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~4.0% to 6.0% (Pakistan holds one of the largest bilateral scholarship allocations)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Marks >= 85% in F.Sc / A-Levels or CGPA >= 3.4 / 4.0 in Bachelor's
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: High-scoring students with clean conduct records, strong recommendations, and complete IBCC/HEC/MoFA attestations.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani intermediate boards and leading engineering/science universities.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Yemen, Egypt, Sudan, Indonesia, Bangladesh, Nigeria, Syria.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of fraudulent agents claiming to sell guaranteed Saudi university visas or scholarship seats.
Official applications are accepted ONLY via https://studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa/.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: The Saudi government NEVER charges any application, processing, or visa fee for government scholarships.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: King Khalid University and the Ministry of Education do not collaborate with educational agencies or consultants.
hidden_costs_breakdown: IBCC, HEC, and MoFA attestations in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000 to 25,000.
Medical diagnostic tests in Pakistan: ~PKR 10,000 to 15,000.
Visa processing via authorized Saudi service centers (Etimad/VFS Tasheel): ~PKR 12,000 to 18,000.
Initial pocket money before first stipend disbursement in Abha: ~SAR 500 (~PKR 37,500).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You need to know Arabic to study engineering or computer science. Reality: Engineering, Computer Science, and Science degrees are taught 100% in English.
Myth: Women cannot apply without a male guardian accompanying them. Reality: Female students are legally accommodated in monitored university female residences under institutional guardianship.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sites claim application deadlines are in December; Saudi government admissions open in May and close in July.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.75 / 5.0 (Grade Good / Jayyid) each semester to retain scholarship benefits.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Minimum 75% class attendance mandatory; falling below 75% results in course denial (Hirman) and stipend suspension.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Biannual academic audit by the Deanship of Student Affairs before disbursing travel tickets and stipends.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Off-campus employment is strictly prohibited under Saudi student visa regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Graduates are expected to return to Pakistan upon graduation; university provides a free final exit ticket.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero financial bond or repayment obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is cancelled and student repatriated if dismissed for academic failure or disciplinary violations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Transferring to another Saudi university is strictly prohibited under external scholarship rules.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Permitted only within the same faculty during the first academic year with approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum extension of one additional semester may be granted upon academic dean's recommendation.

basic_details.offering_entity: Ministry of Education of Saudi Arabia & Najran University (NU)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Najran University Main Campus (Najran, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: College of Computer Science and Information Systems, College of Engineering, College of Science and Arts, College of Administrative Sciences, and College of Sharia (Health/Medical clinical colleges reserved exclusively for Saudi nationals under national policy).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~200 to 300 external international government scholarships allocated annually across faculties
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Generous bilateral quota; Pakistani students constitute a prominent international student group in Najran (~30 to 45 scholarships annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 to 5 years for Bachelor's; 2 years for Master's; 3 to 4 years for PhD (plus 1-year Arabic language preparatory institute if required)
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: SAR 840 / month for undergraduate students (~PKR 63,000 / month); SAR 900 - 1,000 / month for postgraduate students (~PKR 67,500 - 75,000 / month)

basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~50 to 80 tuition merit scholarships awarded per academic cycle across graduate faculties
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open to all nationalities based on academic merit; prominent Pakistani graduate cohort in UAE higher education (~10 to 15 awards annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Normal duration of Master's program (typically 2 years / 4 semesters)
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: AED 0 (Tuition reduction discount only; no monthly living allowance provided)

nationality_requirements: Open to international students and UAE residents of all nationalities (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No strict age limit for graduate study; applicants must meet academic admission standards.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree from an HEC-recognized institution with a minimum CGPA of 3.20 / 4.00 for scholarship eligibility (minimum 3.00 for regular admission). Must obtain degree equivalency from UAE Ministry of Education.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Tiered merit brackets: 40% tuition fee reduction for undergraduate CGPA >= 3.80 / 4.00; 30% reduction for CGPA 3.60 - 3.79; 20% reduction for CGPA 3.20 - 3.59.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Bachelor's degree in relevant or quantitative discipline for IT and Finance programs.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Applicants must have completed Bachelor's degree and hold complete transcripts and certificate.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: 1 to 3 years relevant professional experience required or strongly preferred, particularly for EMBA and Diplomacy programs.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Valid IELTS Academic (minimum 6.0 to 6.5 depending on program) or TOEFL iBT (minimum 79) or EmSAT English (minimum 1400) is mandatory.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; all graduate programs are conducted in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open to both male and female graduate applicants at both Abu Dhabi and Dubai campuses.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Merit scholarships are evaluated and granted automatically upon admission based on verified undergraduate CGPA.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot be combined with another institutional or governmental fee sponsorship.

tuition_fee.details: 20% to 40% tuition fee discount awarded based on undergraduate CGPA tiers (40% discount for CGPA 3.80+, 30% for 3.60-3.79, 20% for 3.20-3.59). Remaining tuition is student responsibility.
tuition_fee.amount: 20% to 40% tuition waiver (approx. AED 18,000 to 45,000 total fee reduction; ~PKR 1,350,000 to 3,375,000)

admission_application_fee.details: Non-refundable application processing fee of AED 420 must be paid directly by the candidate upon portal submission.

accommodation.details: University does not provide free housing for graduate students; students must self-fund private apartment rental in Dubai or Abu Dhabi.
accommodation.amount: Not covered (approx. AED 2,500 to 4,500 / month private rent)

monthly_stipend.details: No living stipend provided; candidates must have personal, family, or employer funds to cover living and accommodation costs.

airfare.details: International travel and relocation flights to the UAE are completely self-funded by the student.

visa_fee.details: University sponsors the UAE student residence visa, but government visa charges, medical screening, and Emirates ID fees (~AED 2,500 to 3,500) are paid by the student.
visa_fee.amount: Approx. AED 3,000 visa costs borne by student

health_insurance.details: Mandatory UAE health insurance coverage must be purchased by the student as a prerequisite for visa stamping.
health_insurance.amount: Approx. AED 1,200 to 2,000 / year borne by student

food_allowance.details: All daily living, groceries, and dining costs are self-funded by the student.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Textbooks and course packs self-funded; digital library access and electronic journal databases are included with university enrollment.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Graduate students can apply to Zayed University Office of Research for student travel grants up to AED 5,000 to present approved papers at international conferences.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to AED 5,000 conference presentation funding

travel_transit_allowance.details: Local transport (Dubai Metro, Abu Dhabi buses, or private commuting) is self-funded.

step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Identify prospective Griffith principal supervisor whose research matches your thesis topic.
Step 2: Contact supervisor via email with CV, transcripts, and 2-page research outline; secure written supervisor endorsement.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: University of Alberta Graduate Online Application System (GSMS)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an applicant profile on GSMS portal, select thesis-based graduate program, identify potential supervisors, upload academic transcripts, English scores, CV, statement of intent, and pay CAD 135 application fee.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Identify eligible thesis supervisor in target academic department and make email contact with CV and research abstract.
Step 2: Ensure valid IELTS (6.5+), TOEFL (90+), or Duolingo (120+) score report is ready.
Step 3: Submit online admission application via GSMS portal and pay CAD 135 fee.
Step 4: Upload official transcripts, CV, statement of intent, and referee contact details.
Step 5: Referees submit electronic assessment letters directly into the GSMS portal.
Step 6: Departmental graduate admissions committee reviews application, offers admission, and automatically nominates top candidates to Faculty of GPS for Graduate Entrance Scholarship.
Step 7: GPS awards entrance scholarship; department supplements with GRA/GTA funding package.
Step 8: Accept offer, receive provincial attestation letter (PAL), and apply for Canadian Study Permit.

basic_details.scholarship_name: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program for Pakistan
basic_details.offering_entity: U.S. Department of State Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs & United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP)

degree_levels: Professional Fellowship (Non-Degree Graduate Study & Professional Affiliation)

basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 10 to 11 months (One full academic year)
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: $2,200 to $2,800 / month tax-free maintenance stipend (~PKR 610,000 to 780,000 / month) plus full international travel, housing, health, and professional development allowance

eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum second division (or CGPA 2.5/4.0); selection is driven primarily by professional achievements, leadership record, and public service commitment.

eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Employed mid-career professionals in the public sector, civil service, NGOs, or private policy institutions.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Minimum 5 years of full-time substantial professional work experience in the relevant field; demonstrated leadership trajectory and commitment to public service.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: TOEFL iBT or IELTS required; USEFP administers or sponsors test vouchers for shortlisted candidates.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None.

eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must hold Pakistani citizenship and commit to returning to Pakistan upon fellowship conclusion.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Ineligible if candidate has studied in the US for more than one academic year in the past 7 years or spent more than 6 months in the US within the last 5 years.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Local transport allowance and travel for required Washington, D.C. Global Leadership Seminar fully paid.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: USEFP Online Application System / IIE Embark Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the USEFP portal, complete biographical and employment histories, draft personal and professional objective essays, upload degree transcripts and employer letters, and register 3 referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check eligibility (Pakistani citizen, 16 years education, minimum 5 years full-time experience).
Step 2: Obtain employer support / no-objection letter confirming leave will be granted.
Step 3: Register and complete the online application on USEFP website (usefp.org).
Step 4: Write comprehensive essays describing professional achievements, fellowship objectives, and return plans.
Step 5: Three referees submit online recommendation letters by the deadline.
Step 6: USEFP screens applications and invites shortlisted candidates for panel interviews in Islamabad.
Step 7: National finalists nominated to the J. William Fulbright Foreign Scholarship Board (FFSB) in Washington, D.C.
Step 8: Final approval announced; fellows placed at host universities, receive J-1 visa, and depart for the U.S. in August.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated State Department Fellowship: USEFP and IIE manage institutional university placement; no separate university admission required.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via automated secure electronic appraisal forms.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Detailed essays addressing: (1) Professional accomplishments, (2) Plan of study and professional affiliation objectives, (3) Expected impact on home institution/country upon return.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Professional development plan outlining graduate courses of interest and target U.S. organizations for the professional affiliation component.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed professional CV listing all positions held, responsibilities, policy documents authored, and leadership milestones.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Rigorous in-person panel interview at USEFP Islamabad with U.S. Embassy diplomats, Pakistani senior civil servants, and Humphrey alumni.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: TOEFL iBT or IELTS required; test vouchers provided to shortlisted candidates by USEFP.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC attested transcripts required for final national nominees.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation of all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via USEFP application portal.

misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: The Humphrey Program grants a Master's degree. Reality: It is an elite non-degree professional leadership fellowship combining graduate courses with a 6-week professional affiliation in a U.S. organization.
Myth: You can remain in the U.S. after the program. Reality: The J-1 visa carries a mandatory 2-year home-country physical presence requirement (Section 212(e)) to return to Pakistan.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sites claim candidates need a GRE; GRE is NOT required for the Humphrey Fellowship.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance in all audited or credited graduate courses.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time resident participation in campus seminars, global leadership workshops, and completion of the mandatory 6-week professional affiliation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Monthly progress reports and midterm reviews with host campus Humphrey coordinator and IIE.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Secondary employment is strictly prohibited under the J-1 Humphrey fellowship regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Mandatory 2-Year Home Country Physical Presence Requirement under U.S. Immigration and Nationality Act Section 212(e); fellows must return to Pakistan for at least 2 years before becoming eligible for U.S. immigrant or work visas.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Obligation to return to Pakistan and contribute to institutional development.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Revocation and financial repayment liability in cases of early unauthorized withdrawal or disciplinary expulsion.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Field of focus must remain consistent with selected program track.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Program duration is strictly 10-11 months; no extensions permitted.

eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree with strong academic record (equivalent to minimum GPA 3.00 / 4.00 or second-division upper / 65%+) from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum undergraduate GPA of 3.0 / 4.0; selection heavily emphasizes professional peacebuilding impact and leadership capacity.

eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated professionals with active employment in peacebuilding, development, or humanitarian sectors.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Must have completed bachelor's degree at least 3 years prior to fellowship start date.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Minimum 3 years of full-time relevant professional work experience in peacebuilding, human rights, conflict mitigation, or sustainable development.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Second language proficiency recommended but not mandatory.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must obtain endorsement from a local Rotary District; active Rotarians, Rotary club members, or their lineal descendants are barred by Rotary Foundation bylaws.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Ineligible if already awarded a Rotary Peace Fellowship.

admission_application_fee.details: Rotary Peace Fellowship application is free; host university graduate application fees are waived or reimbursed by Rotary.

accommodation.details: Housing allowance provided via monthly living stipend; fellows lease private apartments or university graduate housing in Durham / Chapel Hill.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living stipend of $2,200 to $2,600 / month directly deposited to cover rent, utilities, food, and living expenses.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Rotary Foundation Online Peace Fellowship Application Portal (Embark)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an account on the Rotary Peace Fellowships portal, select Master's program track, list Duke-UNC as preferred Peace Center, draft peace essays, upload transcripts and CV, and request endorsement from local Rotary District.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check eligibility (3+ years relevant work experience, not an active Rotarian or lineal relative).
Step 2: Connect with local Rotary District in Pakistan (District 3271 or 3272) to request interview and district endorsement.
Step 3: Complete online Rotary Peace Fellowship application including peace leadership essays and CV.
Step 4: Referees submit letters of recommendation directly into the portal by May 15.
Step 5: Rotary District conducts interview and submits endorsement to The Rotary Foundation by July 1.
Step 6: World-level Rotary Selection Committee reviews dossiers and announces fellowship awards in November.
Step 7: Selected fellows submit formal graduate admission application to Duke University or UNC Chapel Hill by December/January.
Step 8: Universities issue formal admission letters; Rotary processes visa, travel, and stipend for August departure.

application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: District endorsement interview with senior Rotary leaders, followed by potential virtual interview with host university faculty.

application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation of all non-English documents.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Harvard Kenneth C. Griffin Graduate School of Arts and Sciences (GSAS) Online Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on Harvard GSAS application portal, select intended PhD program, list faculty of interest affiliated with HUCE, upload transcripts, statement of purpose, CV, test scores, and register 3 referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Identify faculty researchers affiliated with HUCE across SEAS, EPS, or OEB and review recent publications.
Step 2: Obtain valid TOEFL iBT (100+) or IELTS Academic (7.5+) score report.
Step 3: Submit PhD application on Harvard GSAS portal by December 1 / December 15 deadline.
Step 4: Upload official transcripts, statement of purpose, and curriculum vitae.
Step 5: Three academic referees submit letters directly into the GSAS system.
Step 6: Departmental admissions committee reviews dossiers and conducts virtual technical interviews with shortlisted candidates in January.
Step 7: Successful applicants receive formal admission offer with full 5-year guaranteed funding package and HUCE affiliation.
Step 8: Accept offer by April 15, receive I-20, and apply for U.S. F-1 Student Visa.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Princeton Graduate School Online Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Princeton Graduate School application portal, choose target PhD department, upload academic transcripts, statement of academic purpose, CV, test scores, and register 3 referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore Princeton faculty profiles and published papers in your field of interest.
Step 2: Obtain valid TOEFL iBT (100+) or IELTS Academic (7.0+) score report.
Step 3: Submit PhD application on Princeton Graduate School portal by December 1 / December 15 deadline.

step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Contact potential SYSU faculty supervisors and request a Foreigner Acceptance Letter.
Step 2: Obtain valid English proficiency test or MOI certificate, Foreigner Physical Examination report, and police character certificate.

Step 5: SYSU academic departments review dossiers and conduct virtual interviews for shortlisted candidates.
Step 6: University nominates selected candidates to the China Scholarship Council for final approval.
Step 7: CSC issues official Admission Notice and JW201 Visa Form in July.
Step 8: Apply for Chinese X1 Visa at Chinese Visa Center and travel to Guangzhou/Shenzhen for September registration.

Step 7: MEXT officially confirms scholarship awards in June.
Step 8: Hiroshima University issues Certificate of Eligibility (COE); obtain Japanese Student Visa and depart for Japan in late September.

step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Browse UMPSA research groups and reach out to prospective supervisors with CV and research draft.
Step 2: Obtain signed UMPSA Supervisor Acceptance and GRS Recommendation Form.
Step 3: Submit online admission application via IPS portal and select Graduate Research Scheme (GRS) funding option.
Step 4: Upload attested academic documents, research proposal, passport copy, and English proof.
Step 5: Faculty Graduate Committee conducts technical interview and evaluates project alignment.
Step 6: IPS issues official Letter of Offer and GRS Appointment Letter.
Step 7: Apply for EMGS Visa Approval Letter (VAL) and Single Entry Visa (SEV) at Malaysian High Commission in Islamabad.
Step 8: Arrive in Malaysia, complete medical screening, finalize student pass, and matriculate.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated departmental route: Application for admission and GRS award are evaluated concurrently by the host faculty and IPS.

application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: 5 to 8 page structured research proposal covering problem statement, literature review, methodology, equipment needs, and milestone schedule.

application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical video interview via MS Teams or Google Meet conducted by prospective supervisor and departmental postgraduate coordinator.

step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Contact Tongji University professors in relevant colleges and obtain a Provisional Acceptance Letter.

Step 3: Register on CSC portal (studyinchina.csc.edu.cn), select Program Type B, enter Tongji Agency No. 10247, and submit.
Step 4: Register on Tongji online application portal (study-info.tongji.edu.cn), submit application, and pay CNY 600 fee.
Step 5: College admission committee conducts academic review and schedules video interviews.
Step 6: Tongji Graduate School nominates successful candidates to CSC / Shanghai Municipal Education Commission.
Step 7: Final CSC confirmation issued in June/July with official Admission Notice and JW201/JW202 form.
Step 8: Apply for Chinese X1 Visa at Chinese Visa Center and arrive in Shanghai for September registration.

basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Tsukuba MEXT Special Recommendation Science & Technology Award (University Recommendation IGP)

basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Tsukuba (Tsukuba Science City, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Graduate School of Science and Technology (Pure and Applied Sciences, Systems and Information Engineering, Life and Environmental Sciences), Graduate School of Comprehensive Human Sciences (Informatics, Medical Sciences), and International Degree Programs.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~80 to 110 MEXT University Recommendation scholarships awarded annually across graduate divisions

basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years for Master's; 3 to 4 years for PhD
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: JPY 144,000 / month for Master's (~PKR 273,600 / month); JPY 145,000 / month for PhD (~PKR 275,500 / month) plus 100% tuition waiver and round-trip international airfare

nationality_requirements: Citizens of countries with official diplomatic relations with Japan (Pakistan fully eligible; Japanese dual citizens ineligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Applicants must be born on or after April 2, 1991 (under 35 years old at commencement per MEXT statutory guidelines).
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 16 years of formal education (Bachelor's degree) for Master's; 18 years of education (Master's degree) for PhD from an accredited university with minimum MEXT Grade Point Coefficient of 2.30 out of 3.00.

eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Physics, chemistry, materials science, computer science, electrical engineering, systems engineering, biotechnology, or environmental sciences.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year students completing degree requirements before arrival in Japan (late September).
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior laboratory research experience, computational modeling expertise, or published scientific papers strongly advantageous.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: CEFR Level B2 or higher in English (IELTS Academic 6.5+, TOEFL iBT 80+) or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate; JLPT N2+ accepted for Japanese-medium programs.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Japanese language proficiency is not required for English-taught international programs.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to all qualified applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must establish contact with a Tsukuba prospective faculty advisor and obtain an official Letter of Provisional Acceptance prior to institutional nomination.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Previous MEXT recipients are ineligible unless at least 3 years have elapsed since prior award completion.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full waiver of entrance examination fee (JPY 30,000), admission matriculation fee (JPY 282,000), and annual tuition fees (JPY 535,800/year).

admission_application_fee.details: Screening and entrance examination fees are completely waived for MEXT scholarship nominees.

airfare.details: Economy-class round-trip international flight ticket between Islamabad/Karachi/Lahore and Tokyo Narita/Haneda airport fully covered by MEXT.

visa_fee.details: Japanese Student Visa issued free of charge for MEXT government scholars at the Embassy of Japan in Islamabad or Consulate-General in Karachi.

health_insurance.details: Enrolled in Japan National Health Insurance (NHI) covering 70% of medical costs; subsidized monthly premium (approx. JPY 2,000/month) paid from stipend.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Laboratory research grants and JSPS research project funds cover domestic and international conference participation.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: University of Tsukuba Web Entry System & MEXT University Recommendation Track
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Establish contact with prospective advisor, obtain Letter of Provisional Acceptance, submit application package via departmental graduate office, and complete University Web Entry registration.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Identify and email prospective Tsukuba academic advisors with CV, transcripts, and research proposal (October-November).
Step 2: Participate in informal interview and obtain signed Letter of Provisional Acceptance.
Step 3: Complete MEXT University Recommendation application form and compile certified dossiers (December-January).
Step 4: Prospective supervisor submits internal nomination dossier to Tsukuba Graduate School Selection Board.
Step 5: University conducts internal screening and submits institutional recommendation list to MEXT Tokyo (March).
Step 6: MEXT Tokyo officially ratifies scholarship nominations (June).
Step 7: University issues Certificate of Eligibility (COE) and flight e-tickets; apply for Japanese visa at embassy.
Step 8: Fly to Tokyo Narita/Haneda in late September and start autumn semester on October 1.

application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Field of Study and Research Program Plan (MEXT prescribed form) detailing background, motivation, research objectives, and methodology in Japan.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured academic proposal following MEXT Kenkyu Keikakusho format describing past research, proposed research in Japan, and anticipated scholarly contributions.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic CV detailing education, thesis title, technical skills, publications, and conference presentations.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical interview conducted via Zoom by prospective supervisor and departmental committee evaluating research aptitude.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS 6.5+, TOEFL 80+, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate accepted.

application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Japanese translation for all non-English/non-Japanese documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Electronic submission via Tsukuba Web Entry / departmental graduate office followed by postal dispatch of original documents if requested.

step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check whether your home university is a Yenching Partner Institution (if yes, seek internal nomination; if no, apply via Open Application).
Step 2: Draft personal statement (maximum 750 words) and China-focused research proposal (maximum 1,500 words).
Step 3: Secure two academic letters of recommendation from professors who know your work intimately.
Step 4: Submit complete online application before the strict early-December deadline.
Step 5: International Admissions Committee conducts preliminary dossier screening.
Step 6: Shortlisted candidates invited for a 25-30 minute virtual panel interview in January/February.
Step 7: Final offer notifications sent out in late March / early April.
Step 8: Complete Peking University international student enrollment, obtain JW202/visa, and arrive in Beijing in late August.

application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Research proposal (maximum 1,500 words excluding bibliography) detailing a proposed China-focused academic inquiry within your chosen research track.

application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Highly rigorous 25 to 30 minute video interview conducted by a multidisciplinary panel of Peking University professors and international scholars.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS 7.0+, TOEFL 100+, or official proof of English-medium undergraduate instruction accepted.

step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Contact a prospective academic advisor at UTokyo GSFS by October/November and secure informal consent.

Step 5: GSFS faculty committee conducts academic evaluation and shortlisting.
Step 6: UTokyo nominates shortlisted candidates to the Asian Development Bank (ADB) Headquarters in Manila in March.
Step 7: ADB Board officially ratifies scholarship recipients in June.
Step 8: Obtain Japanese visa and arrive in Japan for late September orientation and October 1 matriculation.

nationality_requirements: Citizens of countries with official diplomatic relations with Japan (Pakistan fully eligible; Japanese dual nationals ineligible)

eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree (for Master's/Integrated) or recognized 18-year Master's degree (for PhD) with minimum MEXT Grade Point Coefficient of 2.30 out of 3.00 from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum MEXT GPA calculation of 2.30 out of 3.00; competitive applicants typically hold MEXT GPA >= 2.70 / 3.00 (equivalent to CGPA >= 3.60 / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Computer science, electrical and electronic engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, chemistry, physics, civil engineering, or life sciences.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year students completing degree requirements before arrival in Japan (late September).
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior publications in peer-reviewed scientific journals or IEEE/ACM conferences provide a major competitive advantage.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5, TOEFL iBT minimum 85, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate demonstrating CEFR B2 or higher.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Japanese language proficiency is not required; all IGP coursework and research are conducted in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to all qualified applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must contact a Tokyo Tech faculty member and receive formal consent to be their academic supervisor before applying.

step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Contact prospective academic advisor at Nagoya University via G30 pre-application inquiry (September-November).

Step 5: Nagoya University submits institutional recommendation list to MEXT Tokyo in March.
Step 6: MEXT Tokyo officially ratifies scholarship awards in June.
Step 7: Receive Certificate of Eligibility, obtain Japanese visa, and receive flight tickets.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: DGIST Graduate Admissions Online Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the DGIST admissions portal, complete online application form, upload personal statement and transcripts, pay USD 50 fee, and dispatch certified physical documents to DGIST Admissions Office.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Contact prospective DGIST professors in target research areas with CV and research interests (July-August for Spring / December-January for Fall).
Step 2: Register on DGIST Graduate Admissions Online System during open intake.
Step 3: Complete online application, upload documents, and pay USD 50 fee.
Step 4: Register two academic recommenders who submit evaluation letters online.
Step 5: Send certified hard-copy documents (degrees, transcripts, apostille/attestation) via DHL to DGIST Admissions Office in Daegu.
Step 6: Departmental faculty committee reviews dossiers and conducts virtual technical interviews.
Step 7: Final admission and scholarship award results announced online.
Step 8: Obtain Certificate of Admission (CoA), apply for South Korean D-2 visa, and arrive in Daegu.

application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research plan detailing proposed technical investigations, methodologies, and alignment with target DGIST laboratories.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic research CV detailing education, laboratory proficiencies, software skills, and publication history.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical interview via Zoom conducted by prospective supervisor and departmental faculty panel.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+, TOEFL iBT 79+, TOEIC 750+, or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate accepted.

basic_details.scholarship_name: Asian Institute of Technology (AIT) Royal Thai Government (RTG) Fellowships
basic_details.offering_entity: Royal Thai Government (RTG) Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation & Asian Institute of Technology (AIT)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Asian Institute of Technology (Pathum Thani Main Campus, Bangkok Metropolitan Region, Thailand)
basic_details.major_restrictions: School of Engineering and Technology (SET), School of Environment, Resources and Development (SERD), and School of Management (SOM) - priority in Civil Engineering, Water Engineering, AI/IoT, Energy, Environmental Management, and Remote Sensing/GIS.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~120 to 180 RTG fellowships awarded annually across Master's and Doctoral programs
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open to Asian developing countries; typically 15 to 25 Pakistani engineering and environmental science scholars selected annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 22-24 months for Master's; up to 36-42 months for PhD
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: His Majesty the King's / Her Majesty the Queen's Fellowships cover 100% full tuition and registration fees (THB 840,000 to 1,260,000 value) plus monthly accommodation and living allowance of THB 11,500 to 15,000 / month (~PKR 86,250 to 112,500 / month)

nationality_requirements: Citizens of Thailand and Asian countries (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No statutory maximum age limit, though priority is given to early-career engineers and researchers.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree with minimum CGPA 3.50/4.00 (for King's/Queen's Full Fellowship) or CGPA 3.00/4.00 (for Loom Nam Khong / RTG Fellowship) from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00 for full coverage King's/Queen's awards; CGPA 3.00 / 4.00 for standard RTG fellowship.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Civil engineering, water resources, environmental engineering, structural engineering, computer science, data science, energy technology, or remote sensing and GIS.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year students completing degree requirements before August/January intake.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Work experience in infrastructure development, water governance, or environmental consulting advantageous but not mandatory.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.0 (writing 6.0), TOEFL iBT minimum 80, AIT English Language Test (AIT-EET score 6.0), or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Thai language proficiency is NOT required; all instruction and research at AIT are conducted 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to all qualified applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants apply online for AIT admission and select Royal Thai Government (RTG) Fellowship on the financial support section.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold any concurrent full scholarship or fellowship.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition and registration fee waiver for standard program duration at AIT.

admission_application_fee.details: AIT international online application processing fee of USD 25 (or THB 800) paid during portal submission.

accommodation.details: On-campus international graduate dormitory accommodation in AIT student villages provided or covered via monthly accommodation allowance.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free subsistence allowance: THB 11,500 to 15,000 / month (~PKR 86,250 to 112,500 / month) disbursed directly for meals and living costs.

visa_fee.details: Thai Non-Immigrant ED Student Visa fee paid directly to the Royal Thai Embassy in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi.

health_insurance.details: AIT Medical Clinic on-campus healthcare and group health insurance plan covering hospitalization.

food_allowance.details: Affordable dining across Aobayana and AIT Cafeteria, including dedicated Muslim Halal dining stalls; meals cost THB 40 to 70.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to AIT Library, geoinformatics labs, regional testing centers, and wind tunnel facilities.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Fieldwork travel and thesis research grant support provided through host academic department and project grants.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Internal campus bicycle network and shared campus transport, plus shuttle vans to Bangkok Red Line commuter rail station (Rangsit).

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the AIT admissions portal, complete postgraduate application form, select Royal Thai Government (RTG) Fellowship on the financial section, upload credentials, and pay USD 25 fee.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check eligibility for RTG King's (SET/SOM), Queen's (SERD), or Loom Nam Khong fellowship categories.
Step 2: Register on AIT admissions portal and complete online application form.
Step 3: Upload transcripts, degree certificates, statement of purpose, and English proficiency test or MOI.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Hans Böckler Foundation Online Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Secure supervision confirmation from German professor, register on HBS application portal during bi-annual intake, upload research exposé, CV, transcripts, and proof of civic engagement, and register academic referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Secure doctoral supervision commitment (Betreuungszusage) from a full professor at an accredited German university.
Step 2: Draft comprehensive 8 to 12-page research proposal (Exposé) detailing methodology, timeline, and socio-economic relevance.
Step 3: Register on Hans Böckler Foundation online portal during open application call (by February 1 or October 1).
Step 4: Upload attested transcripts, CV, exposé, and documentation of socio-political/civic commitment.
Step 5: Academic referees submit formal confidential appraisals directly.
Step 6: Preliminary committee screening and review by external expert reviewers (Fachgutachter).
Step 7: Shortlisted candidates invited for personal/virtual selection interview (Auswahlgespräch) in Germany or via Zoom.
Step 8: Final award decision announced in June (for October start) or December (for April start).
Step 9: Apply for German National Visa and matriculate at host university.

basic_details.scholarship_name: LUT University Master's Scholarship Program & Finland Scholarship Scheme

degree_levels: Master of Science in Technology (MSc Tech)
Master of Science in Economics and Business Administration (MSc Econ)
basic_details.major_restrictions: School of Energy Systems (Energy Technology, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering), School of Engineering Science (Software Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Computational Science, Industrial Engineering), and LUT Business School.

eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No statutory maximum age limit.

eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.20 / 4.00; competitive applicants typically hold CGPA >= 3.50 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Energy technology, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, software engineering, chemical engineering, computational science, data analytics, or international business.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year undergraduate students completing degree requirements before July 31 of enrollment year.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Work experience or technical projects in renewable energy, power systems, software development, or circular economy are advantageous.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 (writing 5.5), TOEFL iBT minimum 88 (writing 20), PTE Academic minimum 62, or recognized English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from an accredited degree-granting institution.

eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to all qualified applicants.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Studyinfo.fi (Opintopolku) Finnish National Joint Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on Studyinfo.fi during the annual application window (December 1 to January 15), select LUT University programs, choose scholarship option, upload documents, and pay €100 application fee.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check program prerequisites and credit requirements on lut.fi.
Step 2: Register on Studyinfo.fi during the application period (December to mid-January).
Step 3: Complete application form and select 'I apply for a scholarship'.
Step 4: Upload attested transcripts, degree certificate, grading scale, CV, and English proficiency certificate.
Step 5: Pay €100 non-EU application fee on Studyinfo.fi.
Step 6: Departmental faculty review committee assesses academic compatibility and ranks applicants.
Step 7: Admission results and scholarship decisions published in late March.
Step 8: Accept study place and scholarship offer by the confirmation deadline (mid-April).
Step 9: Apply online for Finnish Residence Permit via EnterFinland.fi and arrive in Finland in late August.

application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing education, technical skills, projects, and work experience.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No live interviews; some programs require recorded asynchronous video responses embedded in the application.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: ELES Online Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Secure supervision confirmation from German professor, register on ELES application portal during bi-annual intake, upload research exposé, CV, transcripts, and proof of civic engagement, and register academic referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Secure doctoral supervision commitment (Betreuungszusage) from a full professor at an accredited German university.
Step 2: Draft comprehensive 8 to 10-page research proposal (Exposé) detailing methodology, timeline, and scholarly contributions.
Step 3: Register on ELES online application portal during open call (by March 1 or September 1).
Step 4: Upload attested transcripts, CV, exposé, and documentation of socio-political/civic commitment.
Step 5: Academic referees submit formal confidential appraisals directly.
Step 6: Preliminary committee screening and review by external expert reviewers (Fachgutachter).
Step 7: Shortlisted candidates invited for personal/virtual selection interview (Auswahlgespräch).
Step 8: Final award decision announced in July (for October start) or January (for April start).
Step 9: Apply for German National Visa and matriculate at host university.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Separate Routing: Candidates must first secure admission/supervision at a German university, then apply independently to ELES for fellowship funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted directly by two academic professors (one must be the doctoral supervisor) using official ELES evaluation forms.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Detailed essay outlining personal trajectory, motivation, civic engagement, interfaith dialogue, and societal responsibility.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Exhaustive research proposal (8 to 10 pages) outlining research question, state of research, theoretical framework, methodology, and 3-year work plan.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Complete tabular academic CV in German or English detailing education, publications, employment, and social/civic activities.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Rigorous selection interview conducted by an ELES selection committee panel comprising university professors, community leaders, and foundation staff.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 85+ for English doctoral programs; German language proof if applicable.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified true copies of transcripts and degree certificates; HEC and MoFA attestations required for Pakistani credentials.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified German or English translation for all non-German/non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via ELES application portal.
