application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Finnish National Joint Application Portal (Studyinfo.fi)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an account on Studyinfo.fi, fill the joint degree application form, select UEF master's degree programs, select the Finland Scholarship/Waiver consideration box, and upload attested academic documents and language score report.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Review program requirements on UEF official website and prepare electronic copies of degree documents and official English score report (IELTS/TOEFL).
Step 2: Apply online through Finnish National Joint Application Portal (Studyinfo.fi / Opintopolku.fi) between January 7 and January 21.
Step 3: Select the Finland Scholarship / UEF Tuition Waiver option directly on the joint application form (no separate scholarship application required).
Step 4: Upload certified academic transcripts, degree certificates, grading scale, CV, and motivational letter by the document deadline (late January).
Step 5: Take program-specific online aptitude test or video interview if required by the School of Computing.
Step 6: Receive admission and scholarship decision via Studyinfo portal in late March to mid-April.
Step 7: Accept the study place electronically and register at UEF before the confirmation deadline (mid-July).
Step 8: Apply for Finnish Residence Permit for Studies (Migri) via Enter Finland portal using the official UEF admission and scholarship award certificate.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Routing: One single unified application through Studyinfo.fi covers both degree admission and the Finland Scholarship / UEF Tuition Waiver.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by the applicant or sent via electronic referee link if requested by the specific department.

application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Preliminary study interest statement outlining selected elective modules and intended thesis area.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Concise 1 to 2-page CV outlining academic qualifications, technical skills, projects, and certifications.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online video interview or timed written questionnaire for certain computing master's programmes.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+ (min 5.5 writing) or TOEFL iBT 90+ (min 20 writing).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC degree attestation required for Pakistani applicants.

application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Electronic submission via Studyinfo.fi portal.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the DEDS portal, select preferred study track, complete academic history, upload attested degree transcripts, CV, statement of purpose, English test score, and register two academic referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Review DEDS mobility tracks, curriculum modules, and admission criteria on the consortium portal.
Step 2: Prepare all required documents including degree certificates, official transcripts, CV, statement of purpose, and English test scores.
Step 3: Register on the official DEDS Online Application System and select study track preferences.
Step 4: Submit online application before the scholarship deadline (December 31).
Step 5: Undergo rigorous review by the joint Academic Selection Committee (ULB, CentraleSupélec, UPC, TU Berlin).
Step 6: Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an online technical interview in February.
Step 7: Consortium publishes initial ranking and sends scholarship nomination to European Commission (EACEA) in March.
Step 8: Final scholarship award notification delivered in April; candidates receive formal admission and visa facilitation letters.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Swedish Institute Application Portal & University Admissions Sweden
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Apply for master's programs at UniversityAdmissions.se (deadline mid-January). Step 2: Receive 8-digit application number. Step 3: Apply for SI Scholarship on the SI portal in February using mandatory SI templates.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Research eligible master's programmes on the official Swedish Institute website and select up to 4 programmes.
Step 2: Submit master's applications via UniversityAdmissions.se between October 15 and January 15 and pay SEK 900 fee.
Step 3: Upload academic transcripts, degree certificates, and IELTS/TOEFL scorecard to UniversityAdmissions.se before the document deadline (February 1).
Step 4: Prepare mandatory SI application templates: SI CV, Proof of Work and Leadership Experience, and two Letters of Reference.
Step 5: Apply on the Swedish Institute scholarship portal between February 10 and February 28, inputting your 8-digit University Admissions application number.
Step 6: University admissions results announced at UniversityAdmissions.se in late March; candidate must receive an admission offer to remain eligible.
Step 7: Swedish Institute announces scholarship recipients in late April.
Step 8: Accept scholarship offer and apply for Swedish Residence Permit for Studies.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Separate Routing: Candidates must first apply for university admission via national portal UniversityAdmissions.se, then apply separately to the Swedish Institute.

step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Verify academic degree compatibility and specific MSc prerequisites on the TU Delft faculty website.

step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Identify and contact prospective PhD supervisors at Imperial College London whose research aligns with your interests.
Step 2: Obtain written confirmation that the supervisor agrees to support your application for the President's PhD Scholarship.
Step 3: Complete Imperial online postgraduate application before the deadline (January 8 for main round).
Step 4: Select the President's PhD Scholarship scheme in the funding section of the application.
Step 5: Upload your research proposal (maximum 2 pages), academic transcripts, CV, and details of two academic referees.
Step 6: Departmental review committee evaluates candidates and forwards shortlisted nominees to the Central Selection Panel.
Step 7: Shortlisted candidates undergo departmental interviews with faculty members.
Step 8: Final scholarship decisions announced within 6 to 8 weeks following the round deadline.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Contact potential supervisor and submit PhD application via EUCLID. Step 2: Receive 8-digit University User Number (UUN) and MyEd login. Step 3: Access the Scholarship and Funding section in MyEd and complete the Edinburgh Global Research Scholarship online form before January 22.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Identify and secure informal support from a prospective PhD supervisor at Edinburgh.
Step 2: Submit a formal application for admission to a PhD research programme via the University of Edinburgh Degree Finder by early January.

Step 4: Navigate to the 'Scholarship and Funding' channel within MyEd.
Step 5: Complete and submit the Edinburgh Global Research Scholarship application form before January 22, 23:59 GMT.
Step 6: School Selection Panels rank eligible applicants and nominate candidates to the Central College Committee.
Step 7: College Selection Committees review nominations in February and March.
Step 8: Final scholarship decisions announced via email in mid-April.

Step 6: Shortlisted candidates invited for personal or online selection interviews in May.
Step 7: Final fellowship award decisions published in June.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the FES application portal, complete initial questionnaire, submit online basic data by the deadline (November 30 for summer semester, May 31 for winter semester), and upload detailed dossier upon portal invitation.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Secure admission or doctoral supervision at an accredited German university.
Step 2: Submit online preliminary application on the FES portal before November 30 (for summer semester intake).
Step 3: If shortlisted, FES requests full application dossier (academic transcripts, detailed motivation letter, and CV).
Step 4: Register two academic referees and one civic engagement referee to submit appraisals directly.
Step 5: Attend two separate selection interviews (one with a liaison professor assessing academic capability, one with an FES selection committee member assessing socio-political engagement).
Step 6: Central Selection Committee (Auswahlausschuss) makes final award decisions in April.
Step 7: Receive official fellowship award letter and activate funding.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Charles University SIS portal, select Faculty of Mathematics and Physics (Matfyz), choose English master's or PhD programme, upload required documents, tick scholarship consideration, and pay CZK 910 fee before February 28.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check programme curricula and admission guidelines on mff.cuni.cz/en/admissions.
Step 2: Prepare certified academic transcripts, degree certificate, CV, motivation letter, and two referee contacts.
Step 3: Register on Charles University online application portal (SIS).
Step 4: Upload all application documents and apply for an Entrance Examination Waiver based on academic merit before February 28.
Step 5: Pay the CZK 910 application fee online.
Step 6: Matfyz Admissions Committee evaluates applications and awards fellowships to top-ranked candidates.
Step 7: Fellowship and admission award notifications issued in April.
Step 8: Complete Czech nostrification / degree recognition and apply for Czech student visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Routing: Admission application automatically considers eligible candidates for the Faculty of Mathematics and Physics Fellowship.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by applicant or submitted by referees via email/upload link.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose outlining academic achievements, computer science interests, and career ambitions.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: PhD applicants submit a 3 to 5-page research proposal discussing intended thesis topic.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic CV detailing education, programming projects, and algorithmic background.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical interview for PhD candidates or master's applicants requiring oral evaluation.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 85+ / MOI certificate accepted; GRE General Test optional but grants entrance exam waiver.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Nostrification (degree recognition) required by Charles University before enrollment.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Czech translation.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via Charles University SIS portal.

basic_details.scholarship_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds (BIF) International PhD Fellowships
basic_details.offering_entity: Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds (Foundation for Basic Research in Medicine)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Internationally leading biomedical research laboratories (Max Planck Institutes, EMBL Heidelberg, Francis Crick Institute, Oxford, Cambridge, ETH Zurich)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Basic biomedical research aimed at elucidating fundamental biological phenomena of human life (Computational Biology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Structural Biology, Genetics, and Neuroscience).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~40 to 45 prestigious doctoral fellowships awarded worldwide across three annual application cycles
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open internationally to all nationalities; typically 1 to 3 Pakistani biomedical researchers selected per year
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 36 months (initial 2 years + 12-month extension based on scientific progress)

nationality_requirements: Open to researchers of all nationalities worldwide including Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No strict statutory age limit; doctoral candidates must be in the first 6 months of their PhD project or about to start.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 18-year Master's degree (MS / MPhil) in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Computational Biology, or Bioinformatics from an HEC-recognized university with outstanding grades (minimum CGPA 3.70 / 4.00 or 82%+).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.70 / 4.00; competitive applicants typically hold CGPA >= 3.85 / 4.00 with peer-reviewed publications.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Laboratory research in fundamental biomedical science; applied clinical or agricultural studies are excluded.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Master's graduate who has secured a PhD position in an internationally recognized biomedical laboratory.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: PhD project must not have been started more than six months prior to the application deadline.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Proven bench research expertise, structural biology data analysis, or bioinformatics scripting (Python/R) is critical.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Fluent scientific English required for proposal review and selection interviews; IELTS 7.0+, TOEFL 100+, or official MOI certificate.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: German is not required; research is conducted 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Sole focus on basic biomedical research elucidating fundamental biological phenomena.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot receive another full fellowship simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: 100% tuition-free research environment; doctoral fellows are hosted at tuition-free research institutes.

admission_application_fee.details: Applying to Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Covered comfortably from the monthly living stipend; host institutions provide residential assistance.

monthly_stipend.details: Competitive basic monthly stipend of EUR 2,050 to EUR 2,400 / month (~PKR 620,000 - 730,000 / month) adjusted according to host country living costs, plus country supplements.

airfare.details: Travel expenses to and from the host laboratory at the beginning and end of the fellowship are covered.

visa_fee.details: Visa processing and legal registration costs reimbursed upon arrival.

health_insurance.details: Monthly health insurance supplement provided directly to fellows.

food_allowance.details: Covered via monthly EUR 2,050+ stipend plus subsidized campus dining facilities.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full digital access to research libraries, Nature/Cell/Science journals, and computational resources.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Travel allowances for participation in scientific conferences, foundation seminars, and specialized lab workshops.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Full conference and seminar travel grants

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized public transit at host research center location.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple host institutions (any internationally recognized biomedical research laboratory in Germany, Europe, or worldwide).
participating_institutions: Max Planck Institutes (e.g. MPI for Biochemistry, MPI of Molecular Cell Biology and Genetics)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: World top research institutes in basic molecular biology and medicine.
available_majors: PhD in Molecular Biology & Gene Regulation
PhD in Computational Biology & Single-Cell Genomics
PhD in Cellular Neurobiology & Neural Circuitry
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 3 years (36 months: initial 24 months + 12-month extension)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Master's degree (CGPA >= 3.70/4.00), secured PhD laboratory placement with host supervisor agreement, outstanding original research proposal (max 8 pages), CV, and two recommendation letters.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Must have confirmed host laboratory placement before applying; research proposal must demonstrate exceptional scientific originality.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus strictly on basic biomedical research aiming to elucidate fundamental cellular or molecular mechanisms, not clinical drug trials or applied biotechnology.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds Online Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the BIF online portal, select PhD Fellowship application, input project and laboratory details, upload research proposal, CV, degree certificates, and register two referees by the deadline (Feb 1, Jun 1, Oct 1).
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Secure a doctoral position and project in an internationally recognized biomedical research lab.
Step 2: Draft an independent, hypothesis-driven doctoral research proposal (maximum 8 pages including references).
Step 3: Register on the BIF application portal during an open cycle.
Step 4: Upload all application documents before one of the three annual deadlines (February 1, June 1, or October 1).
Step 5: Board of Trustees and external scientific reviewers evaluate scientific quality and feasibility.
Step 6: Shortlisted candidates attend a personal scientific interview with a foundation trustee in Germany or via video call.
Step 7: Final fellowship decisions communicated within 4 to 5 months following the deadline.
Step 8: Activate fellowship and begin funded doctoral research.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Separate Routing: Candidates must independently secure doctoral supervisor and lab placement, then apply to BIF for fellowship funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by the doctoral supervisor and one former academic professor.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Summary of research trajectory, scientific motivations, and long-term academic career goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Rigorous 8-page scientific proposal detailing summary, background, preliminary data, specific aims, experimental design, potential pitfalls, and timeline.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications, lab methods mastered, conferences, and honors.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: In-depth scientific interview conducted by a member of the BIF Board of Trustees probing the applicant's experimental logic and understanding of their field.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS 7.0+ or TOEFL 100+ / MOI certificate accepted.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC degree attestation required for Pakistani applicants.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via BIF portal.

official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sources claim applications are accepted at any stage; BIF strictly enforces that projects started more than 6 months prior to deadline are ineligible.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Fellows may not engage in outside commercial employment; full dedication to the doctoral project is required.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Lab transfers permitted only under exceptional circumstances with prior BIF Board approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Project adjustments within the basic research scope permitted with supervisor agreement.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Standard tenure is 24 months; 12-month extension granted upon application and positive scientific progress review.

basic_details.scholarship_name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Cybersecurity (CYBERUS)
basic_details.offering_entity: European Education and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA) & CYBERUS Consortium
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Université de Bretagne Sud (UBS - Lorient/Vannes, France), Université Libre de Bruxelles (ULB - Brussels, Belgium), University of Tartu (UT - Tartu, Estonia)
degree_levels: Master of Science (MSc / Joint or Double Degree)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Cybersecurity, IoT Security, Software Security, Cryptography, Network Defense, Embedded Systems Security, and Threat Intelligence.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~20 to 24 prestigious Erasmus Mundus scholarship grants awarded globally per cohort
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally under Partner Country quota; typically 2 to 4 Pakistani scholars selected per intake
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 24 months (2 full academic years across at least two European countries)

nationality_requirements: Open to candidates from all countries worldwide, including Pakistan (Partner Country category)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restriction under Erasmus Mundus programme regulations.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 4-year Bachelor of Science (BS / BSc 16-year) in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or Computer Engineering with minimum CGPA 3.30 / 4.00 (75%+).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.30 / 4.00; competitive applicants typically hold CGPA >= 3.65 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Solid foundation in computer networks, operating systems, discrete mathematics, computer architecture, cryptography, and programming (C/C++, Python).
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or enrolled in final undergraduate year graduating prior to July 31 preceding September intake.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: No restriction on year of graduation.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Participation in Capture The Flag (CTF) security competitions, security certifications (CEH, OSCP), or security bug bounties strongly valued.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 (no band below 6.0) or TOEFL iBT minimum 90 (no section below 20). MOI certificates are not accepted by CYBERUS consortium.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Consortium languages (French, Dutch, Estonian) are not required; instruction is 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Erasmus Mundus NDICI / IPA III Partner Country scholarship quota applies to Pakistani nationals.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Candidates who have previously benefited from an Erasmus Mundus Master or Doctoral scholarship are ineligible.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver across all partner universities (worth EUR 18,000 for non-EU students).

admission_application_fee.details: Direct application via CYBERUS consortium portal is completely free.

accommodation.details: Covered directly from the EUR 1,400 / month living allowance; partner universities assist with student residence reservations.

monthly_stipend.details: EUR 1,400 / month tax-free living allowance for up to 24 months (total EUR 33,600 | ~PKR 425,000 / month).

airfare.details: EUR 3,000 per year travel and mobility contribution for Partner Country students living >4,000 km away.

visa_fee.details: EUR 1,000 installation grant covers visa processing, medical attestations, and initial arrival logistics.

health_insurance.details: Full worldwide comprehensive health, emergency, and travel insurance meeting Erasmus+ requirements.

food_allowance.details: Covered via monthly EUR 1,400 living stipend plus access to subsidized campus cafeterias across France, Belgium, and Estonia.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to specialized cyber range environments, virtual labs, and digital scientific libraries.
books_and_materials_allowance.amount: Full university library and cyber range access

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Master thesis internship placements in partner industrial cybersecurity labs (ANSSI, Thales, Airbus Cybersecurity, NATO CCDCOE).

travel_transit_allowance.details: Mobility travel grant between consortium host nations.
travel_transit_allowance.amount: Covered via Erasmus mobility travel budget

university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Leading European centers in cybersecurity, cryptology, and digital defense; direct ties to NATO Cooperative Cyber Defence Centre of Excellence (CCDCOE).

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the CYBERUS portal, select mobility track preference (IoT Cybersecurity or Software Cybersecurity), upload transcripts, CV, statement of purpose, English test score, and register two referees before January 15.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Review CYBERUS tracks, curriculum modules, and admission criteria on master-cyberus.eu.
Step 2: Prepare attested academic transcripts, degree certificate, Europass CV, statement of purpose, and IELTS/TOEFL scorecard.
Step 3: Register on the CYBERUS online application portal.
Step 4: Complete application form and submit all documents before January 15.
Step 5: Consortium Selection Committee reviews applications and scores candidates based on academic and technical backgrounds.
Step 6: Shortlisted candidates attend an online technical interview in February.
Step 7: Consortium publishes initial ranking and sends scholarship nominations to EACEA in March.
Step 8: Final scholarship award notification delivered in April; visa documentation and acceptance letters dispatched.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: EMBL PhD Online Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the EMBL recruitment portal, provide biographical and degree info, select up to 3 preferred research units/Group Leaders, input referee email addresses, and upload CV and academic transcripts before the deadline.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check eligibility criteria and review current research projects and Group Leaders at EMBL.
Step 2: Create an account on the EMBL PhD recruitment portal.
Step 3: Complete academic history, research experience summary, and choice of research units.
Step 4: Register two academic referees who will receive automated requests to upload letters before the referee deadline.
Step 5: Submit the online application by mid-April (Summer call) or mid-October (Winter call).
Step 6: EMBL Faculty panel conducts initial screening and reviews shortlisted candidates.
Step 7: Selected candidates undergo online video interviews and are invited to EMBL Interview Days.

basic_details.scholarship_name: Geneva Academy Scholarships in International Humanitarian Law & Human Rights
basic_details.offering_entity: Geneva Academy of International Humanitarian Law and Human Rights (Joint Center of the University of Geneva & Geneva Graduate Institute - IHEID)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Geneva Academy of International Humanitarian Law and Human Rights (Villa Moynier, Geneva, Switzerland)
basic_details.major_restrictions: LL.M. in International Humanitarian Law and Human Rights (LL.M. IHL) and Master of Advanced Studies in Transitional Justice, Human Rights and the Rule of Law (MTJ).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~15 to 20 full and partial scholarships awarded annually across both Master's programmes
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition with focus on candidates from developing and conflict-affected nations; typically 1 to 2 Pakistani legal scholars/advocates selected per intake
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 10 months (full academic year from September to June covering the 1-year intensive Master's degree)

nationality_requirements: Open to international legal graduates and human rights advocates worldwide, with strong priority for candidates from non-Western/developing countries including Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No rigid age ceiling; targeted at young legal practitioners, judicial officers, and civil society advocates under 40.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Full degree in law (LLB, BA-LLB 5-year, or equivalent recognized law degree) or another degree with significant legal coursework, from an HEC/Pakistan Bar Council-recognized university with high academic distinction (minimum CGPA 3.30 / 4.00 or 75%+).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.30 / 4.00; competitive legal candidates typically hold CGPA >= 3.60 / 4.00 or rank in the top 10% of their law school class.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Recognized law degree (LLB) with solid background in public international law, constitutional law, human rights, or criminal law.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated with full primary law degree prior to commencement in September.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Practical experience in legal advocacy, judicial clerkships, human rights NGOs, ICRC/Red Crescent work, or moot court competitions is highly valued.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 7.0 (with no band below 6.5) or TOEFL iBT minimum 100. MOI certificates may be considered if previous law degree was conducted entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Instruction is in English (with bilingual optional courses in French for the LL.M.). Passive knowledge of French is advantageous but not mandatory.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Full scholarships are reserved specifically for outstanding candidates from non-Western/developing countries who demonstrate that they cannot study in Geneva without financial support.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another full institutional scholarship concurrently.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver for the intensive 10-month Master's programme (CHF 18,000 value).

admission_application_fee.details: Geneva Academy online application fee of CHF 100 payable during submission.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living allowance of CHF 1,800 per month for 10 months (~PKR 590,000 / month | CHF 18,000 total) to cover rent, meals, and living costs in Geneva.

airfare.details: International travel expenses between Pakistan and Geneva are self-funded or covered from personal savings.

visa_fee.details: Swiss student visa application fee and cantonal residence permit (Permis B) charges in Geneva (~CHF 200 - 300) covered by student.

health_insurance.details: Contribution towards mandatory Swiss health and accident insurance (LAMal student policy) provided through the scholarship package.
health_insurance.amount: Swiss student health insurance contribution covered

food_allowance.details: Subsidized cafeterias at Villa Moynier, Graduate Institute, and Uni Mail; covered via monthly CHF 1,800 living stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to the Geneva Academy Library, Graduate Institute Kathryn and Shelby Cullom Davis Library, and UN Library Geneva.

research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Study trips to international courts included

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized Geneva public transit (Unireso / tpg monthly student pass).

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Geneva Academy Online Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Geneva Academy application portal, select chosen Master's programme, tick the box requesting a scholarship, complete all personal/academic sections, upload required legal credentials, and submit before late January.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check eligibility criteria and review curriculum for the LL.M. or MTJ programme.
Step 2: Create an account on the Geneva Academy online admissions portal.
Step 3: Fill in biographical, academic, and professional experience sections.
Step 4: Check the box indicating request for a full or partial scholarship.
Step 5: Upload your motivation letter explaining both academic interest and financial circumstances.
Step 6: Upload LLB degree certificate, transcripts, CV, and two letters of recommendation.
Step 7: Upload household income documentation demonstrating financial need.
Step 8: Pay the CHF 100 application fee and submit the application before January 27.
Step 9: Selection committee reviews applications and communicates decisions in March/April.
Step 10: Confirm scholarship acceptance and apply for the Swiss entry visa.

application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard legal CV detailing education, moot court competitions, legal publications, internships, and bar admissions.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interview; selections are based entirely on academic transcripts, legal credentials, motivation letter, and references.

basic_details.scholarship_name: Northern Border University International Scholarship (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)

nationality_requirements: International applicants holding non-Saudi citizenship (Pakistan fully eligible)

eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: HSSC / Intermediate (Pre-Engineering, ICS, or Pre-Medical) or Cambridge A-Levels for Bachelor's (minimum 80% marks or Grade B); recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree (BS / BE / BSc 4-year) in Computing or Engineering for Master's from an HEC-recognized university with minimum CGPA 3.00 / 4.00 or Very Good (Jayyid Jiddan) standing.

eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not required; research papers or programming portfolio advantageous for postgraduate computing applicants.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Instruction in Faculty of Computing and Information Technology and Engineering is 100% in English (MOI certificate from Pakistani university accepted; IELTS 5.5+ or TOEFL 65 recommended). eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Non-Arabic speaking students enrolled in Arabic-track courses undergo an intensive 1-year preparatory Arabic language program.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Female applicants must either reside with an authorized legal male guardian (Mahram) possessing valid Iqama in Saudi Arabia or obtain admission under institutional residential guardianship in monitored university female dormitories.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Unified external scholarship selection conducted via the official Ministry of Education 'Study in Saudi' portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa).

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Study in Saudi Official Platform (Ministry of Education, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an applicant profile on the 'Study in Saudi' portal (https://studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa/), select 'External Scholarship (منحة خارجية)', choose Al-Baha University as first preference, specify Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology, and upload certified document scans.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Attest educational certificates (Matric/Inter or BS) through IBCC or HEC, followed by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) Pakistan.
Step 2: Obtain an official police character clearance certificate and a comprehensive medical fitness certificate from an authorized diagnostic lab.
Step 3: Register an account on the Saudi Ministry of Education Study in Saudi portal (https://studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa/).
Step 4: Select Al-Baha University, choose Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology and degree level, and upload all required PDF credentials.
Step 5: Al-Baha University Deanship of Admission reviews applications and submits shortlisted nominations to the Ministry of Education.
Step 6: Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) issues an electronic visa authorization number (Visa Slip / Tafweez).
Step 7: Submit passport for visa stamping via authorized Saudi Visa Service Centers (Etimad / VFS Tasheel) in Pakistan; university issues e-ticket to Al-Baha.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Unified Government System: Single application via the Study in Saudi portal simultaneously processes university academic admission and the full government scholarship award.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded as attested scanned PDF documents on official institutional letterhead bearing referee contact details and official stamps.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Brief statement of purpose (in English or Arabic) detailing academic objectives, passion for computing/technology, and motivation to study in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: For Master's applicants: 2 to 3-page research synopsis outlining proposed thesis domain in computer science or software engineering.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard tabular CV outlining educational qualifications, academic percentage/CGPA, software skills, and extracurricular activities.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Screening is entirely document- and merit-based; no mandatory video interview is conducted for undergraduate external scholarships.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: English proficiency certificate (IELTS/TOEFL) or Medium of Instruction (MOI) letter; no mandatory GRE/GAT required for external admissions.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: IBCC (for Matric/Inter), HEC (for Bachelor degrees), and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) Pakistan attestations are strictly mandatory.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Arabic translations of all educational documents, transcripts, and police clearance certificates.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online submission via the Ministry of Education Study in Saudi portal.

red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Al-Baha University strictly disclaims any affiliation with educational agencies; direct personal application is required.

Initial pocket money before first monthly stipend disbursement in Al-Baha: ~SAR 500 (~PKR 37,500).

Myth: Students must pay back their tuition if they return to Pakistan. Reality: The scholarship is a non-repayable government grant with zero financial bond.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial social media pages claim applications are accepted year-round; the official Study in Saudi portal strictly operates on an annual summer intake (May-July).

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.75 / 5.0 (Grade Good / Jayyid) each academic semester to retain full scholarship benefits.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Minimum 75% classroom and laboratory attendance required; falling below 75% results in course disqualification (Hirman) and stipend forfeiture.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-by-semester academic audit conducted by the Deanship of Student Affairs prior to releasing tickets and monthly stipends.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Off-campus employment is strictly prohibited under Saudi student residence laws (Iqama regulations).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Scholars are expected to return to Pakistan upon graduation; the university issues a final exit visa and complimentary return air ticket.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or repayment obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is terminated and the student is repatriated if dismissed for academic failure, exam misconduct, or violation of Saudi laws.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Transferring between Saudi universities is strictly prohibited under the external scholarship charter.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Permitted only within the same faculty during the first academic year with approval of the College Dean.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum extension of one additional semester may be approved upon Dean's recommendation in case of justified academic delay.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Saudi Ministry of Education Unified 'Study in Saudi' (Minhati) Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create a unified applicant profile on the Saudi Ministry of Education portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa), select University of Bisha as destination institution, choose desired computing major, and upload required verified credentials.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Attest academic certificates and transcripts from IBCC/HEC and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) Pakistan; arrange certified Arabic translations.
Step 2: Obtain Police Character Clearance Certificate from Police Khidmat Markaz and get it attested by MOFA Pakistan.
Step 3: Register on the official Saudi 'Study in Saudi' portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa) during the September-November application window.
Step 4: Select University of Bisha and submit choice of degree program in the College of Computing and Information Technology.
Step 5: Upload high-resolution scans of passport, attested degrees, medical report, character certificate, and recommendation letters.
Step 6: University of Bisha Admissions Committee conducts academic screening and ranks candidates under the Pakistan country quota (25 seats).
Step 7: Shortlisted nominees undergo Saudi Ministry of Education and Ministry of Foreign Affairs administrative and security vetting (April - June).
Step 8: Final scholarship award notification issued; MOE generates electronic visa authorization number (Visa Slip).
Step 9: Complete medical screening at GAMCA-approved medical center in Pakistan, submit passport to Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi for Student Visa stamping.
Step 10: University issues complimentary electronic flight ticket; arrive at Abha/Bisha Airport for university reception and hostel check-in.

application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose outlining academic drive, moral character, and aspirations to contribute to technological development upon degree completion.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required for undergraduate applicants; Master's applicants provide a 2 to 3-page research proposal in computer science or information systems.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic CV detailing education history, software skills, academic distinctions, and language proficiencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interview is required; selection is determined entirely by academic credentials, quota distribution, and background vetting.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: None mandatory. General Tahsili / Qudurat tests are not required for external international candidates.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Attestation by IBCC/HEC and MOFA Pakistan, followed by Saudi Cultural Mission and Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia upon final selection.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified Arabic translation for all Pakistani educational degrees, marksheets, and police clearance certificates.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the unified Study in Saudi portal.

Step 2: Create an applicant profile on the PSUT online admission portal.
Step 3: Complete personal, educational, and referee details, and upload scanned transcripts, degree certificates, passport, and CV.
Step 4: Upload valid English proficiency test score (IELTS min 6.0 or TOEFL iBT min 79).
Step 5: Pay the non-refundable application fee of JOD 50 online.
Step 6: Submit application before the deadline (June 30 for Fall intake).
Step 7: Attend online departmental technical interview with faculty admissions committee.
Step 8: Upon receiving admission offer, apply for the PSUT Excellence Scholarship / Graduate Assistantship through the Deanship of Graduate Studies.
Step 9: Selection committee reviews academic dossiers and allocates scholarship awards.

Step 2: Once admitted, log into Banner Self-Service and submit the Graduate Fellowship application before April 1.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore graduate programs and faculty research profiles on aucegypt.edu.
Step 2: Submit graduate degree application via AUC online admissions portal before January 15 (Fall intake) or October 1 (Spring intake).
Step 3: Upload transcripts, degree certificates, CV, statement of purpose, and English proficiency test scores.
Step 4: Pay non-refundable application fee of USD 50.
Step 5: Receive formal notification of graduate admission from AUC Office of Graduate Admissions.
Step 6: Access the AUC Graduate Fellowships portal and select eligible fellowship categories (e.g. University Fellowships, Departmental Fellowships).
Step 7: Upload fellowship essays and research statement before the fellowship deadline (April 1).
Step 8: Graduate Studies Committee evaluates academic merit, departmental needs, and faculty nominations.
Step 9: Fellowship award notifications dispatched by early June.
Step 10: Accept fellowship contract, complete Egyptian student visa paperwork, and enroll in courses.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Visit portal.ku.edu.kw, create graduate applicant account, select 'College of Graduate Studies - Non-Kuwaiti Scholarship Track', complete bio-data, academic qualifications, and upload required documents before March 31.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Review graduate program specifications, department prerequisites, and scholarship terms on the College of Graduate Studies portal (graduate.edu.kw).
Step 2: Prepare HEC/MoFA-attested academic transcripts, degree certificates, valid IELTS/TOEFL scorecard, and GRE score report.
Step 3: Register an account on Kuwait University Student Information System (portal.ku.edu.kw) during the annual application window (mid-January to late March).
Step 4: Select preferred graduate degree program and indicate application for the Non-Kuwaiti Graduate Scholarship.
Step 5: Upload all required academic credentials, statement of purpose, CV, and passport scans, and pay the KWD 10 application fee online.
Step 6: Register two academic referees who will submit letters of recommendation directly into the university system.
Step 7: Department Graduate Studies Committees review files and conduct virtual interviews for shortlisted candidates between April and May.
Step 8: College of Graduate Studies issues official admission and scholarship nomination letters in June/July; Kuwait University handles security clearance and student visa issuance.

application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online video interview via Microsoft Teams/Zoom conducted by departmental graduate admissions panel testing technical background and research motivation.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.0+ or TOEFL iBT 75+; GRE General Test recommended or required by College of Engineering (quantitative score >= 150).

application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via Kuwait University Student Information System (portal.ku.edu.kw).

eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Advanced background in econometric modeling, optimization methods, Python/R/GAMS programming, energy systems simulation, or energy market policy.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Currently enrolled in an accredited PhD program (having completed doctoral coursework / comprehensive exams) or recent doctoral graduate.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Must have achieved PhD candidacy within the last 3 years.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior research publications in peer-reviewed energy or economics journals (Energy Economics, Applied Energy, Energy Policy) strongly elevate selection chances.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 7.0 (no band below 6.5) or TOEFL iBT minimum 95. Research, publications, and seminars are conducted 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Arabic language is not required; research environment is entirely international and English-medium.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to male and female scholars; KAPSARC compound provides international residential facilities.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Elite research fellowship awarded to scholars producing high-impact policy analysis on global energy transitions.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Fellows must dedicate full effort to their KAPSARC research program during the fellowship period.

tuition_fee.details: 100% coverage of all institutional research fees, affiliation costs, and computing cluster access at KAPSARC's Zaha Hadid-designed research center in Riyadh.

admission_application_fee.details: Direct application via KAPSARC Fellowship Portal is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free luxurious furnished residential townhouse/villa provided within the secure KAPSARC Residential Community in Riyadh (fully serviced with utilities, high-speed fiber internet, and gym/pool amenities).
accommodation.amount: 100% Free luxury furnished residential housing on KAPSARC compound

monthly_stipend.details: Tax-free monthly research fellowship stipend of SAR 5,000 / month (~PKR 370,000 / month | ~USD 1,335/month | SAR 60,000/year).

airfare.details: Round-trip economy international airfare between Pakistan and Riyadh King Khalid International Airport (RUH) provided at the start and completion of the fellowship.

visa_fee.details: Saudi Business/Research Visa or Saudi Residency Permit (Iqama) fully sponsored, processed, and paid by KAPSARC.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive premium health and emergency medical insurance through Bupa Arabia covering top private hospitals in Riyadh.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized dining at KAPSARC executive dining hall, cafés, and on-compound markets, complemented by the SAR 5,000 monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full digital and physical access to KAPSARC Library, proprietary global energy databases (BloombergNEF, S&P Global Platts, Rystad Energy, IEA).
books_and_materials_allowance.amount: 100% Access to premier global energy data repositories

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Full financial sponsorship to present research at premier international energy conferences (IAEE, USAEE, COP) and publish KAPSARC Discussion Papers.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free shuttle transportation between KAPSARC residential compound, research complex, and key Riyadh destinations.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: KAPSARC Fellowship & Careers Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Visit kapsarc.org/careers/visiting-fellowships/, create an applicant profile, select 'Visiting Doctoral Fellowship', upload detailed research proposal, writing sample, transcripts, CV, and letters of recommendation before March 1.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Review KAPSARC research themes, active projects, and fellow profiles at kapsarc.org.
Step 2: Draft a comprehensive 5 to 10-page research proposal detailing research objectives, methodology (econometric or optimization), data sources, and policy implications.
Step 3: Prepare academic transcripts, proof of PhD enrollment / candidacy, writing sample (published paper or dissertation chapter), and English test score.
Step 4: Submit the complete application package through KAPSARC Careers / Visiting Fellowships online portal by March 1.
Step 5: KAPSARC Research Directors and Senior Fellows review proposals and evaluate methodological rigor and policy relevance.
Step 6: Shortlisted candidates are invited for a virtual seminar presentation (research seminar + interview) with the KAPSARC research panel in April.
Step 7: Final fellowship award decisions announced in May.
Step 8: KAPSARC Human Resources processes Saudi research visa, flights, and compound housing allocation for Fall arrival.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Routing: Fellowship application directly submitted to KAPSARC provides both institutional affiliation and complete funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted by two doctoral advisors or senior faculty members via referee email upload link.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Motivation letter (1,000 words) describing doctoral research trajectory, motivation for joining KAPSARC in Riyadh, and how the center's resources will advance the candidate's career.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Rigorous 5 to 10-page research proposal specifying: research questions, theoretical framework, quantitative econometric/computational methodology, required datasets, and expected policy deliverables (e.g., KAPSARC Discussion Paper).
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Full academic curriculum vitae detailing doctoral coursework, working papers, journal publications, software skills (Python, R, GAMS, Stata), and conference presentations.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online research seminar presentation (30 minutes presentation followed by 20 minutes Q&A) before KAPSARC Program Directors and Senior Fellows.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 7.0+ or TOEFL iBT 95+; GRE scores advantageous for quantitative economics candidates.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC and MoFA Pakistan degree attestations required for Saudi visa processing; Saudi Embassy attestation.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official English translation for all academic records.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via KAPSARC Careers / Visiting Fellowships portal.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official KAPSARC website at https://www.kapsarc.org/.
Never pay any fee; KAPSARC never charges application, processing, or visa fees.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application to KAPSARC fellowships is 100% free.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: KAPSARC does not work with commercial placement agencies or recruiters for research fellowships.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Application fee: SAR 0 (Free).
Saudi visa and flights: 100% COVERED by KAPSARC upon selection.
Attestation fees in Pakistan (HEC/MoFA/Saudi Embassy): ~PKR 25,000 - 45,000.
Pre-departure medical tests (GAMCA): ~PKR 20,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: KAPSARC is an oil production company. Reality: KAPSARC is an independent, non-profit energy and sustainability research think tank located in Riyadh.
Myth: Fellows must relocate permanently. Reality: This is an in-residence doctoral fellowship spanning 6-12 months designed to support PhD dissertation completion.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial websites state that Arabic proficiency is required to work at KAPSARC; the working language across all research teams at KAPSARC is 100% English.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain active doctoral candidacy in good standing at home university.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical residency at KAPSARC research complex in Riyadh during the fellowship tenure; participation in weekly research seminars.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Quarterly milestone reviews with assigned KAPSARC mentor and Program Director.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Fellows must devote full time to their designated research project; outside commercial consulting is prohibited.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Scholars return to their home university to defend and complete their PhD degree upon fellowship conclusion.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Fellows must produce at least one KAPSARC Discussion Paper or Policy Brief and present at an internal research seminar.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Revocation of fellowship and termination of residency in case of research misconduct, plagiarism, or abandonment of project without cause.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Not applicable (fellow remains matriculated at home doctoral university).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Research topic modifications require formal approval from KAPSARC Program Director.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Initial 6-month fellowship can be extended up to 12 or 24 months based on exceptional research progress and joint publication deliverables.
